title: Supplier Engineer
description:
**Company Description**
It started with a simple idea: what if surgery could be less invasive and recovery less painful? Nearly 30 years later, that question still fuels everything we do at
**Intuitive**
. As a global leader in
**robotic-assisted surgery**
and
**minimally invasive care**
, our technologies—like the
**da Vinci surgical system**
and
**Ion**
—have transformed how care is delivered for millions of patients worldwide.
  
  
We’re a team of engineers, clinicians, and innovators united by one purpose: to make surgery smarter, safer, and more human. Every day, our work helps care teams perform with greater precision and patients recover faster, improving outcomes around the world.
  
  
The problems we solve demand creativity, rigor, and collaboration. The work is challenging, but deeply meaningful—because every improvement we make has the potential to change a life.
  
  
If you’re ready to contribute to something bigger than yourself and help
**transform the future of healthcare**
, you’ll find your purpose here.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Primary Function:**
In this role, a Supplier Engineer is responsible for ensuring suppliers meet ISI requirements for quality, service, delivery, and cost. Drive suppliers to continuously improve business and manufacturing processes. Evaluate and select suppliers. Guide Engineering in choosing suppliers for new products and provide DFM input to new designs to support NPI projects. Executes detailed projects with suppliers to ensure excellence across quality, cost, capacity, risk management, and sub-supplier management.
  
  
**Roles And Responsibilities**

* Drive PCBA manufacturing qualification at contract manufacturers, including readiness requirements and milestone reviews.
* Provide PCB/PCBA DFM feedback and escalate manufacturability risks early in product development.
* Complete project/ part qualification deliverables including: Supplier pFMEA, Process Validations (IQ/OQ/PQ), Inspection Reports, Gage R&R, and Process Capability Analysis
* Develop and implement manufacturing technologies and process improvements to enhance quality, reliability, throughput, and cost.
* Work with suppliers to execute cost reductions, capacity improvements, and risk mitigation
* Select the right process and supplier for the part, considering long term fit and total ownership cost
* Manage supplier changes including manufacturing process changes, production optimization, facility changes, new equipment qualification, and new line validations
* Drive changes to ISI requirements as necessary by initiating and managing changes to specifications and drawings through the engineering change order process
* Own and drive to closure supplier variances from symptom through root cause analysis to corrective action, including careful CAPA documentation
* Effectively prioritize and advance multiple concurrent projects and tasks
* Clearly communicate project status to key stakeholders
* Build, own, and relentlessly pursue a vision for developing suppliers
* Understand proper level of documentation detail for tracking of actions and justification of decisions
* Generate key metrics for the team and suppliers, and continually drive for timely achievement of those metrics
* Drive suppliers to continually improve their business and manufacturing process performance to meet Intuitive’s requirements for supplier excellence using a collection of best practices in project management, Six Sigma, Lean, SPC and negotiation. Lead these efforts without managerial guidance at several suppliers simultaneously
* Implement corrective and preventive actions for supplier process by driving supplier’s investigations and root cause analysis
* Provide effective and timely supply base health information and recommendation to management by creating and delivering data-driven supply base information to any level of management at ISI with little or no guidance
* Prepare and deliver supplier communications as required by independently working with suppliers on scorecard creation
* Work with suppliers and ISI design engineering for the new product introduction to:
* Create product supplier landscapes to determine launch readiness and report to management
* Develop supplier ramp readiness plans by judging business risk based on forecast, supplier capacity, quality performance, and process capability.
* DFM by engaging suppliers early in development cycle to feedback manufacturability improvements in the designs prior to production
* Influence and guide Design Engineering in choosing suppliers by determining selection criteria for preferred suppliers and leading the team effort to evaluate preferred suppliers
* Review, analyze and close customer complaints, manufacturing variance requests, and first article inspections by judging risk analyses and justifications
* Evaluate corrective and preventive actions at suppliers, looks for opportunities with suppliers to eliminate recurrence

**Qualifications**
**Skills/Job Requirements:**

* Minimum 3 yrs related experience in engineering/manufacturing of Electronics (PCBA, PCA, cable assemblies, wiring harnesses, etc.) preferred.
* Experience with board assembly processes and equipment, including stencil, paste print, SPI, pick and place, SMT reflow, AOI, AXI, selective solder, flying probe, wash, and conformal coating.
* PCBA DFM experience
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills including presentations to executive level management
* Excellent Interpersonal, team building and project management skills
* Demonstrable knowledge in evaluating and challenging supplier technical, quality, and business capabilities
* Demonstrable knowledge of a wide range of manufacturing processes including understanding of key input variables for quality, cost, and capacity
* Excellent knowledge of 21 CFR part 820 and ISO 13485
* Significant computer experience using Windows, Word, Excel, Project, Access, and ERP Information Systems, preferably SAP or Agile

**Required Education And Training**

* Minimum Education: BS degree in Engineering or equivalent experience, advanced degree preferred
* Experience with SMT/PCBA manufacturing and process development
* Experience in a high-volume medical device company is a plus

**Working Conditions**

* Ability to travel to suppliers on an as-needed basis – domestic and international.

**Preferred Skills And Experience**

* Medical Device experience is a plus
* Supplier management experience is a plus
* Advanced degree preferred
* DFM tools experience, such as Valor or Allegro, is a plus.
* Experience with statistical analysis software such as Minitab is a plus
* Experience in a high-volume medical device company is a plus

Additional Information
  
  
Intuitive is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. We provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and employees, and prohibit discrimination and harassment of any type, without regard to race, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, color, age, religion, protected veteran or disability status, genetic information or any other status protected under federal, state, or local applicable laws.

title: Implementation Engineer
description:
**Job Description – Implementation Engineer (SaaS & AI)**
**Company:**
MAKO IT LAB
  
  
**Experience:**
2–5 Years
  
  
**Location:**
Chennai – Work from Office
  
  
**Shift Timing:**
4:00 PM – 1:00 AM IST
  
  
**Employment Type:**
Full-Time
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for a customer-focused and technically capable
**Implementation Engineer**
to join our SaaS Implementation team.
  
  
The ideal candidate will be responsible for understanding customer requirements, designing practical solutions, configuring SaaS platforms, and delivering successful implementations.
  
  
This role combines
**solution consulting, SaaS implementation, basic Python programming, AI-assisted automation, and customer engagement**
.
  
  
The candidate should be comfortable interacting directly with international customers, translating their business requirements into functional solutions, and independently managing implementation activities.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Customer Discovery & Solution Consulting
* Engage with customers to understand their business requirements, workflows, and implementation objectives.
* Conduct requirement-gathering sessions and solution discussions.
* Recommend appropriate product features, configurations, and workflows.
* Translate business requirements into functional specifications and implementation plans.
* Identify technical limitations, dependencies, and potential implementation risks.
* SaaS Product Implementation
* Configure SaaS platforms, including workflows, templates, custom fields, user roles, permissions, dashboards, and automation rules.
* Implement solutions based on approved customer requirements.
* Support data imports, mapping, migration, and validation activities.
* Troubleshoot configuration issues and resolve implementation challenges.
* Manage multiple customer implementations while maintaining delivery quality and timelines.
* Python & Technical Integration
* Write and modify basic Python scripts for data processing, validation, and automation.
* Work with REST APIs, JSON payloads, and webhooks.
* Use Python to support API interactions, data transformations, and implementation utilities.
* Assist integration teams with troubleshooting and technical validation.
* Collaborate with developers on complex customizations and third-party integrations.
* AI & Automation
* Use AI-powered tools to improve implementation efficiency, troubleshooting, and documentation.
* Apply AI-assisted coding tools to develop and optimize basic Python scripts.
* Explore opportunities to automate repetitive implementation tasks.
* Understand fundamental AI concepts, including LLMs, prompt engineering, and AI-assisted workflows.
* Demonstrate an interest in learning and working with AI-driven implementation platforms.
* Customer Training & Go-Live
* Conduct product demonstrations, configuration walkthroughs, and customer training sessions.
* Coordinate User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and resolve identified issues.
* Prepare implementation documentation, configuration guides, and handover materials.
* Support go-live activities and post-implementation stabilization.
* Ensure a smooth handover to Customer Success and Support teams.
* Project Ownership & Communication
* Independently own assigned implementation activities and smaller customer projects.
* Provide regular status updates to customers and internal stakeholders.
* Track project milestones, deliverables, risks, and dependencies.
* Proactively identify blockers and escalate issues when necessary.
* Maintain clear documentation and follow established implementation processes.

Mandatory Skills
  
  

* 2–5 years of experience in SaaS implementation, technical implementation, or solution consulting.
* Hands-on experience with SaaS product configuration and customer onboarding.
* Basic Python programming knowledge is mandatory, including scripting, data manipulation, and API interactions.
* Working knowledge of REST APIs, JSON, webhooks, and Postman.
* Familiarity with AI technologies and tools is mandatory, including practical exposure to generative AI or AI-assisted development.
* Strong business requirement analysis and problem-solving skills.
* Good verbal and written English communication skills.
* Ability to independently interact with customers and recommend suitable solutions.
* Willingness to work from the Chennai office during the 4:00 PM – 1:00 AM IST shift.

Good to Have
  
  

* Experience with CRM, PSA, project management, or customer onboarding platforms.
* Exposure to Salesforce, Zoho, HubSpot, Monday.com, or similar SaaS products.
* Knowledge of SQL, data migration, and data transformation.
* Experience with Workato, Zapier, Make, or similar integration platforms.
* Familiarity with AI coding assistants such as ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot, or Cursor.
* Understanding of LLM APIs, prompt engineering, and AI workflow automation.
* Experience working with US-based customers.

What We Expect
  
  

* Strong ownership of customer implementations from discovery to go-live.
* A solution-oriented mindset rather than a task-execution approach.
* Ability to combine business understanding with technical capabilities.
* Willingness to continuously learn new SaaS products, Python, AI technologies, and automation tools.
* Strong communication, documentation, and customer management skills.
* Proactive identification of risks and timely escalation of blockers.
* Commitment to implementation quality, customer satisfaction, and delivery timelines.

title: Master Data Quality Manager
description:
**Company Description**
DigAIT is a scientific technology and consulting partner that helps organizations in the chemical and life sciences industries accelerate digital transformation. The company combines AI, IT, scientific data, and deep domain expertise to improve processes across research, development, laboratories, manufacturing, and operations. Its services span process modeling, laboratory and manufacturing solutions, data analytics, business intelligence, and advanced machine learning and generative AI. DigAIT also provides data stewardship, integration, and knowledge management, supported by strong capabilities in platforms such as SAP Signavio, LIMS, ELN, MES, ERP, Power BI, Tableau, AWS, Azure, Python, and modern AI/LLM tools. The mission is to make scientific processes more connected, intelligent, data-driven, and scalable for clients worldwide.

**Role Description**

We are looking for a technically strong professional with a background in chemistry, materials science or a related discipline to support our client in profiling the quality, consistency and reliability of formulation, materials and testing data. The role combines scientific domain knowledge with hands-on data quality management. You will work with laboratory teams, formulation scientists, R&D specialists and other business stakeholders to review and profile data, identify inconsistencies, coordinate data cleansing and improve the quality of information used across the organisation.The ideal candidate has practical experience in a laboratory environment, particularly in formulation development, materials testing or product development, and understands how formulation and testing data are generated, recorded, interpreted and maintained.

You should be comfortable working directly with data as well as engaging with subject-matter experts to investigate issues, validate information and ensure that data is accurate, complete, consistent and fit for purpose.

**Key responsibilities**

**1. Data quality monitoring**

* Monitor and assess the quality of formulation, materials, raw material, test methods and related technical data.
* Perform data profiling and quality checks to identify missing information, inconsistencies, duplicate records, incorrect attributes and deviations from agreed standards.
* Review formulation and materials records to assess completeness, consistency and accuracy against technical requirements and established data definitions.
* Identify data anomalies and investigate discrepancies in formulation information, material properties, test results and associated records.
* Develop and maintain data quality rules, validation checks and monitoring processes.
* Track data quality metrics and identify recurring issues and opportunities for improvement.

**2. Data Cleansing and Remediation**

* Coordinate data clean-up and remediation activities to improve the quality and consistency of existing datasets.
* Work closely with formulation scientists, laboratory personnel, materials specialists and data owners to investigate and resolve data discrepancies.
* Validate corrections with relevant subject-matter experts to ensure that changes are scientifically appropriate and accurately reflect the underlying technical information.
* Identify root causes of recurring data quality issues and recommend preventive measures.
* Maintain clear records of identified issues, corrective actions, decisions and resolution status.
* Follow up with stakeholders to ensure that outstanding data issues are resolved in a timely manner.

**3. Scientific and Technical Data understanding**

* Apply knowledge of chemistry, materials science and laboratory practices to understand the context and meaning of technical data.
* Understand how formulations are developed, tested, evaluated and documented in a laboratory or R&D environment.
* Review formulation-related information, including raw materials, ingredients, compositions, material properties, test parameters and results, where applicable to the organisation's data.
* Engage with technical experts to clarify data definitions, resolve ambiguities and establish appropriate data quality requirements.
* Help distinguish genuine data quality issues from legitimate technical variations in formulations, materials or testing conditions.
* Support the development of consistent terminology, data definitions and standards for scientific and technical information.

**4. Data governance and standardization**

* Support the establishment and maintenance of data standards, validation rules and governance practices for formulation and materials data.
* Improve consistency in the way technical information is captured, classified, named, structured and maintained.
* Work with data owners and business stakeholders to clarify ownership, responsibilities and processes for maintaining data quality.
* Document data definitions, business rules, quality requirements and standard operating procedures.
* Promote consistent data management practices across relevant laboratory, R&D and business teams.
* Identify opportunities to strengthen data controls and improve the reliability of data at the point of creation.

**5. Stakeholder collaboration and user support**

* Act as a key contact for data quality issues relating to formulation, materials and laboratory information.
* Work directly with users to understand data-related challenges, clarify requirements and agree on corrective actions.
* Collaborate with laboratory teams, formulation scientists, R&D, quality and IT or data management teams to resolve issues.
* Support users in understanding data standards and maintaining accurate and complete records.
* Communicate findings and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Encourage accountability for data quality and promote continuous improvement in data management practices.

**6. Reporting and continuous improvement**

* Prepare reports and dashboards to communicate data quality performance, outstanding issues and remediation progress.
* Monitor trends in data quality and identify areas requiring further investigation or corrective action.
* Recommend improvements to data capture, validation, maintenance and review processes.
* Support initiatives to improve the accessibility, consistency and usability of formulation and materials data.
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of data quality processes and practices across the organisation.

**Qualifications**

* Degree in Chemistry, Materials Science, Chemical Engineering, Polymer Science or a related scientific or engineering discipline.
* Strong practical background in a chemistry or materials science laboratory, with particular experience in formulation development, materials testing, product development or a related R&D environment.
* Good understanding of how formulations and materials are developed, tested, characterised and documented.
* Experience working with technical or scientific data, including reviewing, validating, analysing or maintaining formulation, material or laboratory records.
* Strong analytical skills and the ability to identify inconsistencies, investigate discrepancies and assess data quality systematically.
* Ability to work directly with laboratory users, scientists and technical stakeholders to clarify information and resolve data issues.
* Strong attention to detail, organisational skills and a structured approach to problem-solving.
* Clear communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively across scientific, technical and business functions.
* A proactive mindset with the ability to follow through on issues and drive improvements to completion.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in formulation development or testing involving chemicals, polymers, coatings, adhesives, specialty materials or other formulated products.
* Experience managing, reviewing or cleaning technical datasets, laboratory records, product specifications or formulation databases.
* Familiarity with laboratory information management systems (LIMS), electronic laboratory notebooks (ELN), product lifecycle management (PLM), ERP systems or materials management platforms.
* Experience with Excel, SQL, Power BI or similar tools for data profiling, analysis, validation and reporting.
* Exposure to data governance, master data management, data stewardship or formal data quality processes.
* Experience working with R&D, product development, analytical testing, quality control or technical service teams.

description:
**About Us:**
Barry-Wehmiller is a diversified global supplier of engineering consulting and manufacturing technology for the packaging, corrugating, sheeting and paper-converting industries. By blending people-centric leadership with disciplined operational strategies and purpose-driven growth, Barry-Wehmiller has become a $3 billion organization with nearly 12,000 team members united by a common belief: to use the power of business to build a better world.
  
  
**Job Description:**
**Join Us. Build a Better World Through Business.**
At Barry-Wehmiller Companies, we believe business can be a powerful force for good. Headquartered in St. Louis, Missouri, we are a global leader in manufacturing technology and services. Since our founding in 1885 as a maker of brewing machinery, we’ve grown through the acquisition of more than 80 companies, serving industries such as packaging, paper converting, sheeting, corrugating, engineering, and IT consulting. In 2016, we ranked No. 10 on the St. Louis Business Journal list of the city’s Top 150 Privately Held Companies.
  
  
What truly sets us apart is our culture—rooted in Truly Human Leadership, a philosophy that prioritizes the well-being and growth of every individual. We measure success by the way we touch lives, not just by financial results.
  
  
In India, Barry-Wehmiller operates as a hub of innovation and collaboration through our Global Competency Center (GCC) and other strategic functions. The GCC houses centers of excellence in engineering, content management, sourcing, software development, global IT operations, and shared financial services—providing critical support to Barry-Wehmiller divisions worldwide.
  
  
**Our culture is built on:**

* Ownership – Drive features end-to-end, from design to deployment.
* Flexibility – A friendly, results-oriented environment that respects your time.
* Empowerment – Your ideas matter, and your work creates visible impact.
* Learning and Growth – Tackle complex challenges alongside passionate peers, with continuous support for your development.

**Career Development and Global Exposure**
At Barry-Wehmiller, your growth is our priority. You’ll have access to world-class learning programs, leadership development opportunities, and mentorship from industry experts. Our global footprint means you’ll collaborate with teams across continents, gaining exposure to diverse markets, cutting-edge technologies, and best practices from around the world. Whether you aspire to deepen your technical expertise or take on leadership roles, we provide the resources and support to help you thrive.
  
  
If you’re ready to bring your best thinking to a high-impact, future-focused environment—where long-term stability meets start-up agility—and be part of a company that cares deeply about people, we’d love to hear from you.
  
  
**Position Description:**
Under general direction, the Engineering Systems Analyst drives strategies to improve engineering processes and ensure systems and tools are efficient and optimized. The individual will provide functional and technical expertise in identifying, evaluating, and developing systems and procedures that are cost effective and meet user requirements while directly supporting engineering initiatives from the business. They will assist in designing the structure of our engineering systems and carry out programs to ensure the proper architecture is implemented. Provide hands-on experience in software development and be able to manage complex programs. They will also assist in designing, building, and updating database structures and SQL queries. You will then deploy engineering solutions assuring its implementation, effectiveness, adaptability, responsiveness, quality, governance, and the continuous improvement. This role is responsible for providing technical assistance to other engineers. This role also frequently provides guidance to engineering staff, using extensive experience to manage the prioritization, development and completion of technology projects.
  
  
**Principal Duties and Responsibilities (Essential Functions):**

* Maintain and administer PDM and CAD systems, databases, and infrastructure. Optimize systems for efficiency and security.
* Partner with users to understand PDM, CAD, and drafting concerns, troubleshoot issues, and propose process improvements to increase user efficiency and experience.
* Troubleshoot PDM and CAD issues with the end user base. Perform root cause analysis to develop, test, and implement fixes that prevent recurrence.
* Develop and deliver training for PDM and CAD products. Establish and communicate PDM and CAD best practices. Standardize PDM and CAD environments across all workstations.
* Work with IT to develop and support communication protocols between PDM and other data systems as required.
* Manage licenses for PDM and CAD software and add-ons.
* Evaluate, maintain, and develop new tools to support the end user base.
* Evaluate operating systems and upgrades to manage impact on CAD servers and workstations
* Attends and participates, as an ‘ambassador’ for testing, in project meetings regarding solution of the requirements, design, and test plan review.
* Maintain a working knowledge of advancing technologies. Identify applicable solutions and implement with existing networks when appropriate.
* Identify creative ways to reduce cost by streamlining processes and systems (i.e. modification of responsibilities, consolidation or tasks, elimination of non-value added processes and re-engineering processes and systems).
* Drive continuous improvement through trend reporting analysis and metrics management leveraging PowerBI and other similar tools.
* Participate in blueprinting and mapping sessions with customers for PDM, Change Management, and Migrations.
* Analyze requirements and contribute to the design of CAD/PDM solutions to complex requirements
* Design and execute implementations for PDM, Change Management, and Migrations
* Mentor and collaborate with services team members on design, documentation, and implementations
* SQL queries and analysis
* Participate in large project support, system/application implementations and upgrades.
* Assist with the long term migration to standard engineering tools.
* Designing and maintaining custom applications.
* Collaborate with DBAs and Infrastructure teams.

**Job Specifications:**

* Extensive knowledge and experience in Engineering PDM and CAD applications including SolidWorks and Autodesk products
* Broad understanding of the engineering new product development process and how CAD and PDM/PLM play a role within that process.
* Excellent team player.
* Strong logic, problem solving ability, takes initiative.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills

**Required Education and Experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in engineering, IT, or related technical field required
* Typically has 4+ years’ engineering or IT experience
* BlueStar PLM experience preferred

**Supervisory/Responsibility:**

* Indicate if individual contributor w/no direct reports or if supervise direct reports & level of reports (individual contributors, supervisors, managers, etc.)

**Work Environment:**
Works in an office environment but may occasionally be exposed to manufacturing conditions to include noise, fumes, Odors, gases, dust, and hazards such as moving mechanical and electrical machinery. Required Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) will be provided to mitigate or eliminate these hazards and all employees will be trained on appropriate use of PPE.
  
  
**Position Type:**
This is a regular, full-time position with the understanding that a regular workweek will require extended days and hours as needed to meet business needs.
  
  
**Travel:**
No travel is expected for this position
  
  
**Physical Demands:**
OFFICE
  
  
The physical demands described here are representative of the those performed in the job duties. The employee sits at a desk and uses a computer for prolonged periods of time. Performing the role frequently uses close vision, speech, hearing, and dexterity to operate office equipment. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 15 pounds.

title: Engineer, Product Applications
description:
To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology.
  
  
**Group/Division**
The Semiconductor Products and Customers (Semi PC) business unit designs, builds and sells KLA’s product portfolio to help chip manufacturers meet high-quality standards for technologies like AI, data centers, automotive and electronic devices. Our inspection, metrology, and analytics systems detect and monitor defects across logic and memory chips, specialty semiconductors, wafers, reticles, advanced packaging, process equipment and materials. We also develop technologies for specialty processes, IC substrates, and PCB manufacturing, including etch and deposition, component inspection, and imaging and analytics. The Broadband Plasma (BBP) division is the market-leading optical inspection system used by logic, foundry, and memory customers to detect critical defects at advanced nodes. These tools combine broadband plasma technology with unmatched sensitivity and speed to support high-volume manufacturing.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high-impact work across your area of expertise.
  
  
**Application Development Engineer**
**Responsibilities:**

* Customer support: Product value demonstration during beta testing, Head-to-Heads (H2H) and tools in the ramp phase, thereby enabling product penetration/adoption at world-wide customers. This includes-investigating semiconductor manufacturing yield issues and providing inspection solutions; creating & sharing product value statements and use-cases with engineering, marketing and sales groups; training customers and other applications engineers.
* Product Demonstration: Provide specific product demonstrations on all aspects of highly complex products to customers and assess potential applications to meet customer needs
* Product Characterization: Work on test plan development and execute detailed characterization of the tool/algorithm performance and provides clear feedback to the Engineering teams for product improvement, especially during Alpha/Beta tests.
* Problem Diagnosis/Troubleshooting: Respond to customer requests and perform routine to moderately complex problem diagnosis and problem resolution.
* Customer Relationship: Interacts with customers to educate and coordinate activities. Good working knowledge of customer use case and is expected to understand customer needs and improve customer relations.
* Training: Conduct customer product demonstrations and technical training including on-site training of Field Applications Engineers and end users.
* Documentation: Document all test results and lessons learned in BKMs (Best Known Methods), training documents, Demo reports, or, Alpha/Beta test reports and transfer product knowledge to Field Applications teams.
* Presentation/Communication Skills: Generate demo and test reports and strong presentation skills for internal and customer review.

**Requirements:**

* We are looking for high energy, self-driven and motivated engineers who are interested in working in High Tech. The semiconductor space is a fast paced, high stress environment that gives applications engineers a lot of autonomy to work and drive projects on their own. Ideal candidates appreciate the opportunity to have high levels of accountability, working well with limited supervision and thrive in a work environment where they can drive projects on their own.
* Candidate must have Master’s or bachelor's degree in Engineering, Physics, Material Science, or related fields.
* Must have excellent oral and written communication, organizational, analytical, and interpersonal skills.
* Candidate must be a strong team player.
* >50% travel will be required

**Minimum Qualifications**
Master's Level Degree and 0 years related work experience; Bachelor's Level Degree and related work experience of 2 years
  
  
**About KLA**
We provide advanced inspection tools, metrology systems, process solutions, and computational analytics that make electronics possible, tackling complex challenges. From electron and photon optics to machine learning and data analytics, we seek perfection at the most fundamental level of matter in the universe. If you want to make electronics that push industries forward and make the world a better place, join us.

title: Manufacturing Engineering Manager
description:
**Senior Manufacturing & Production Quality Lead – LifeBand**

**Location:**
India – predominantly on-site in Chennai

**Engagement:**
Contract, Full Time

**Reporting to:**
Equivital UK Product & Operations Leadership

**Product:**
Equivital LifeBand – first high-volume production run of 2,000 units

**Role purpose**

Equivital is seeking experienced electronics manufacturing professional to provide hands-on leadership and oversight of the first high-volume production run of approximately 2,000 LifeBand devices at our manufacturing partner in India.

This is a critical production-launch role. The successful candidate will act as Equivital's senior on-site manufacturing representative and will be responsible for ensuring that the production process is properly controlled, technically robust and capable of delivering a consistently high-quality product at the required yield.

The individual will work closely with the manufacturing company in Chennai and quality teams, Equivital's UK engineering and product teams, and other technical stakeholders.

The role requires someone who is comfortable working directly on the factory floor, identifying problems, challenging poor processes, implementing corrective actions and communicating clearly with both factory personnel and senior technical teams in the UK.

**Key objectives**

The successful candidate will be accountable for:

* Excellent build quality across the 2,000-unit production run.
* High first-pass yield and minimal rework/scrap.
* Successful integration of the new ATE into the production process.
* Implementation and control of the new final DFT testing process.
* Robust control and verification of the LifeBand welding process.
* Ensuring welded assemblies meet the required mechanical and electrical specifications, particularly those affecting pogo-pin performance.
* Accurate material, component and finished-goods traceability.
* Improved stock control and production material management at Manufacturing plant.
* Rapid identification, containment and resolution of production issues.
* Accurate production reporting to the UK team.
* Establishment of a repeatable production process that Manufacturing company can continue to operate after the launch phase.

**Key responsibilities**

**1. Production launch and daily manufacturing oversight**

* Be Equivital's principal technical and operational representative on-site during the production run.
* Work closely with Manufacturing company production, engineering and quality personnel.
* Review and approve production readiness before volume manufacturing begins.
* Establish clear daily production targets and monitor actual performance.
* Monitor production flow from incoming components through assembly, welding, programming, testing, final inspection and packing.
* Identify bottlenecks, recurring defects and process weaknesses.
* Challenge processes that are not producing the required quality or yield.
* Have authority to recommend or initiate a production stop where there is a significant quality or product-risk issue.

**2. ATE implementation**

The successful candidate will:

* Work with Equivital engineering and manufacturing company to embed the ATE into the production process.
* Ensure operators understand the correct test procedure.
* Verify that the ATE is correctly configured and being used consistently.
* Establish appropriate test records and traceability.
* Monitor ATE failure rates and identified abnormal trends.
* Distinguish genuine product failures from test-equipment/operator/process failures.
* Ensure failed units are correctly quarantined and investigated.
* Ensure that production does not bypass required ATE testing.
* Work with engineering to refine the ATE process where necessary.

**3. Final DFT implementation**

Final Design-for-Test / DFT testing is a new element of the LifeBand production process.

The role will be responsible for:

* Implementing the final DFT test process on the production line.
* Ensuring appropriate test fixtures, equipment and procedures are available.
* Training and supervising operators.
* Ensuring 100% of required devices receive the defined final testing.
* Ensuring test results are recorded and traceable to individual units.
* Monitoring DFT failure modes and trends.
* Working with Equivital engineering to investigate recurring failures.
* Preventing units from progressing to final packing without completing the required tests.

**4. Welding process control**

A particularly important responsibility will be oversight of the LifeBand welding process.

The successful candidate must have practical experience of manufacturing processes involving small electronic assemblies and understand the failure modes associated with welding/joining processes.

They will:

* Establish and document the required welding process parameters.
* Verify that the welding equipment is correctly set up and maintained.
* Ensure operators are trained and following the approved process.
* Establish appropriate first-off and periodic inspection requirements.
* Monitor weld quality throughout production.
* Identify potential weld defects before they become downstream failures.
* Ensure appropriate mechanical/electrical verification of the weld.
* Investigate weld-related failures and implement corrective actions.
* Pay particular attention to the impact of the welding process on the alignment, positioning and reliability of the LifeBand pogo-pin interface.
* Ensure the finished assembly meets the required mechanical tolerances and electrical performance requirements.

Experience with welding or joining of small electronic assemblies, plastics, metals, flexes, contacts or similar precision components would be highly desirable.

**5. Quality and yield management**

Establish and maintain a clear production-quality dashboard covering, at minimum:

* First-pass yield (FPY)
* Overall yield
* Scrap
* Rework
* ATE failures
* DFT failures
* Welding defects
* Pogo-pin/contact failures
* Functional test failures
* Component/assembly defects
* Repeat failure modes
* Units quarantined
* Units released
* Production throughput

The successful candidate will identify trends rather than simply report numbers.

Where yield deteriorates, they will determine the likely root cause and drive corrective action.

**6. Factory process discipline and stock control**

Manufacturing company currently requires improved production discipline and material control.

The role will therefore include:

* Verification of component availability before production starts.
* Physical verification of critical stock where required.
* Improving accuracy between recorded and actual stock.
* Ensuring components are correctly identified and traceable.
* Preventing uncontrolled substitution of components.
* Ensuring rejected/failed components are segregated.
* Establishing appropriate quarantine and disposition processes.
* Identifying shortages before they stop production.
* Ensuring finished and semi-finished units can be reconciled against production records.

**7. Non-conformance and root-cause analysis**

The individual will lead or coordinate investigation of manufacturing defects.

They should be comfortable using appropriate techniques including:

* CAPA
* Non-Conformance
* Process capability analysis where appropriate

The objective is not simply to repair defective units but to prevent recurrence.

**8. Communication with the UK team**

Provide a concise daily/weekly production report to Equivital UK covering:

**Production**

* Units planned, completed, passed, failed, yield, Rework/scrap

**Quality**

* Top defects, ATE failures, DFT failures, Welding defects, Contact/pogo-pin issues, Open NCRs

**Operations**

* Stock/component issues
* Production constraints
* Staffing/process issues
* Risks to schedule

**Actions**

* Corrective actions completed
* Actions in progress
* Decisions required from the UK team

Significant quality issues should be escalated immediately rather than waiting for the weekly report.

**Authority**

The individual must have sufficient authority to:

* Stop or pause production where a significant quality issue is identified.
* Quarantine suspect product.
* Require re-testing or additional inspection.
* Challenge production processes that do not meet the agreed specification.
* Escalate unresolved issues directly to Equivital UK leadership.

The role is not intended to be a passive inspection position.

**Required experience**

**Essential**

* Significant experience in electronics manufacturing.
* Experience managing or overseeing production of electronic devices/products.
* Strong understanding of manufacturing quality systems.
* Hands-on experience with production testing and test equipment.
* Experience implementing or managing ATE or automated production testing.
* Experience with DFT/functional testing.
* Experience with precision manufacturing processes involving small components.
* Practical experience with welding, joining or equivalent manufacturing processes involving small electronic assemblies.
* Strong understanding of process control, yield and defect analysis.
* Strong communication skills in English.
* Ability to work directly with factory operators, engineers and management.
* Comfortable working on the factory floor rather than purely in an office environment.

**Highly desirable**

* Experience with wearables, medical devices, IoT devices, consumer electronics, industrial electronics or similar products.
* Experience with high-volume electronics manufacturing.
* Experience with SMT/PCBA and final assembly.
* Experience with pogo pins, spring contacts, connectors or similar electrical interfaces.
* Experience establishing production test fixtures and traceability systems.
* Experience working with international companies or overseas engineering teams within regulated manufacturing environment.
* Experience with ISO 9001, ISO 13485 or similar quality systems.
* Engineering degree in Electronics, Electrical, Mechanical, Manufacturing or a related discipline.

**Personal characteristics**

The successful candidate will be:

* Technically credible.
* Hands-on and practical.
* Highly organised.
* Detail-oriented without losing sight of production objectives.
* Comfortable challenging poor processes.
* Calm under production pressure.
* Commercially aware.
* Strong enough to represent Equivital's interests with the manufacturing partner.
* Excellent at communicating technical issues simply and clearly to UK-based colleagues.

title: Lead System Engineer
description:
**Job Description Summary**
Systems Engineering ist eine funktionsübergreifende technische Disziplin, die sich auf einen Ansatz, eine Denkweise und einen Prozess konzentriert. Alle Tätigkeiten, die sowohl die geschäftlichen als auch die technischen Anforderungen der Kunden berücksichtigen, mit dem Ziel, ein Qualitätsprodukt bereitzustellen, das die Anforderungen der Benutzer erfüllt. Die Disziplin zur Umsetzung eines soliden Prozesses zum Entwerfen, Erstellen und Optimieren von Systemen, der aus der Identifizierung und Quantifizierung von Systemanforderungen, der Erstellung alternativer Systementwurfskonzepte, der Durchführung von Design-Trade-off-Studien, der Auswahl und Implementierung der besten Entwürfe und der Überprüfung der Tatsache besteht, dass das Design ordnungsgemäß integriert ist und ausgeführt wird. Prozess, der vom Konzept über die Produktion bis zum Betrieb verläuft.
  
  
Beeinflusst die Qualität der eigenen Arbeit und der Arbeit anderer im Team.Führt betriebliche/technische Standardaufgaben aus, die in der Regel Anweisungen und Arbeitsabläufen unterliegen.Möglicherweise besteht Spielraum, um die Reihenfolge zu ändern und Aufgaben/Pflichten basierend auf sich ändernden Arbeitssituationen zu erledigen.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Rollen und Verantwortlichkeiten**

* Führt Komponenten- und Produktintegration durch. Alle Aktivitäten, die mehrere Komponenten und Produkte umfassen und sich mit der Integration für maximale Leistung und Bedienbarkeit befassen. Verwaltet Produkt- und Systemanforderungen, Spezifikationen und den Datenfluss. Führt Validierungs- und Verifizierungsaktivitäten für das gesamte Produkt/System durch, einschließlich Tests auf Systemebene. Verantwortlich für die Definition der Produktanforderungen für das Modul/die Komponente/Subunternehmer und Partnerteams. Verwaltet die Schnittstelle zwischen Komponenten und Ausführungsorganisationen. Verantwortlich für das Vorantreiben von CTQ/Risk-Trades innerhalb der Teams, die die Komponenten entwerfen. Verwaltet die Gesamtproduktkonfiguration und das Konfigurationssteuerungssystem.
* Erweiterung der Kenntnisse der eigenen technischen Disziplin zur Umsetzung von Richtlinien/Strategien.Kann Support-Rollen mit spezialisiertem technischem Wissensgebiet beinhalten; laufender Erwerb von Kenntnissen und Fähigkeiten auf höherem Niveau.
* Grundlegendes Verständnis der wichtigsten Geschäftstreiber; nutzt dieses Verständnis, um eigene Arbeit zu leisten.Gute Kenntnisse darüber, wie sich die Arbeit des eigenen Teams in andere Teams integriert und zum Bereich beiträgt.
* Kann eine gewisse Autonomie besitzen, um Entscheidungen innerhalb eines definierten Rahmens zu treffen.Löst Probleme in Situationen, in denen gute technische Kenntnisse und Urteilsvermögen im Rahmen festgelegter Verfahren erforderlich sind.Konsultiert hochrangigere Teammitglieder zu Problemen außerhalb definierter Anweisungen/Parameter.
* Eine Stelle auf diesem Niveau erfordert gute zwischenmenschliche Fähigkeiten und kann notwendig sein, um ein Junior-Team zu führen.Entwickelt für kundenorientierte Rollen starke Kundenbeziehungen und dient als Schnittstelle zwischen Kunden und GE Vernova.Erklärt anderen technische Informationen.

**Grundqualifikationen**

* Diese Rolle erfordert grundlegende Erfahrung . Der Wissensstand ist vergleichbar mit einem Bachelor-Abschluss einer akkreditierten Universität oder Hochschule (oder einem Abitur mit entsprechender Erfahrung).

**Gewünschte Eigenschaften**

* Sehr gute mündliche und schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten. Ausgeprägte Sozialkompetenz und Führungsqualitäten. Fähigkeit, selbständig zu arbeiten. Starke Fähigkeiten zur Problemlösung.Hinweis:Um die Einwanderungsbestimmungen der USA und andere gesetzliche Anforderungen zu erfüllen, muss die Mindestanzahl der Jahre an Erfahrung angegeben werden, die für eine Tätigkeit in den USA erforderlich sind.Für Rollen außerhalb der USA sollten sich die JDs auf das für die Rolle erforderliche inhaltliche Erfahrungsniveau konzentrieren, um die Einhaltung der geltenden Rechtsvorschriften zu gewährleisten, und eine Mindestanzahl von Jahren sollte NICHT verwendet werden.Diese Stellenbeschreibung soll einen allgemeinen Leitfaden für die Rolle liefern.Sie soll jedoch nicht die von jedem Mitarbeiter gemäß dem jeweiligen Arbeitsvertrag und/oder gemäß einer anderweitigen Vereinbarung zwischen einem Mitarbeiter und seinem Vorgesetzten geforderten Pflichten ändern oder anderweitig einzuschränken/erweitern.

**Relocation Assistance Provided:**
Yes

title: AI Quality Engineer, Safety and RAG - Assistant Vice President
description:
We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced AI Quality Engineer to join our Retail and Wealth Risk Engineering team under the Enterprise Risk Technology platform. This role spans the full spectrum of modern AI quality engineering — from
**Agentic AI flow testing**
and
**RAG pipeline validation**
to
**AI safety, test automation**
, and
**performance & reliability engineering**
.
  
  
You will be the quality pillar for complex autonomous AI systems, ensuring they are
**safe, accurate, explainable, resilient, and production-ready**
at scale. This is a high-impact, highly technical role that requires both depth in AI/ML and breadth across testing disciplines.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Agentic AI Testing
  
  

* Design and execute end-to-end test strategies for Agentic AI pipelines, including single-agent and multi-agent workflows.
* Validate agent reasoning, planning, and decision-making chains (e.g., ReAct, Chain-of-Thought, Plan-and-Execute, Reflexion).
* Test tool-use correctness — ensuring agents invoke the right tools, with correct parameters, at the right time.
* Evaluate agent memory systems (short-term, long-term, episodic) for accuracy and context retention across sessions.
* Validate agent handoff and delegation logic in multi-agent orchestration frameworks (e.g., AutoGen, CrewAI, LangGraph).
* Test termination conditions, loop detection, and infinite loop prevention in autonomous agent loops.

RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) Testing
  
  

* Design comprehensive test strategies for end-to-end RAG pipelines — covering ingestion, chunking, embedding, retrieval, reranking, and generation stages.
* Validate retrieval accuracy and relevance — ensuring the correct context chunks are retrieved for a given query.
* Test embedding model quality and vector similarity thresholds across different document corpora.
* Evaluate faithfulness, groundedness, and answer relevance of generated responses using frameworks like RAGAS, TruLens, DeepEval.
* Test chunking strategies (fixed, semantic, hierarchical) for their impact on retrieval quality.
* Validate context window management — ensuring retrieved context does not exceed token limits or degrade generation quality.
* Conduct end-to-end regression testing when the underlying knowledge base, embedding model, or LLM changes.
* Test multi-turn conversational RAG for context coherence and citation accuracy across turns.

Test Automation
  
  

* Build and maintain automated test harnesses for Agentic and RAG systems, including agent trajectory replay, tool mock injection, and prompt simulation.
* Develop automated evaluation pipelines integrated into CI/CD workflows for continuous model and agent validation.
* Create data validation and data quality frameworks (using Great Expectations, Deequ, or custom tooling) for training, retrieval, and inference data.
* Build prompt regression suites to detect behavioral drift across LLM versions or prompt changes.
* Implement determinism and reproducibility tests for stochastic LLM-based decisions.
* Automate vector database validation — index integrity, embedding drift, and retrieval consistency checks.

**AI Safety & Security Testing**

* Conduct red-teaming and adversarial testing to uncover jailbreaks, prompt injection vulnerabilities, and goal misalignment in LLM-based systems.
* Test output guardrails and content filters for unsafe, biased, toxic, or out-of-scope model behavior.
* Validate privilege escalation controls — ensuring agents do not exceed permitted actions or access unauthorized resources.
* Perform data poisoning and backdoor attack simulations to assess model robustness.
* Evaluate models for bias, fairness, and discrimination using frameworks such as AI Fairness 360 and Aequitas.
* Test PII leakage and data privacy controls in RAG and agent pipelines in accordance with GDPR, CCPA, and internal data governance policies.
* Conduct security testing aligned with the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, including:

+ Prompt Injection (Direct & Indirect)
+ Insecure Output Handling
+ Training Data Poisoning
+ Insecure Plugin / Tool Design
+ Sensitive Information Disclosure

* Validate constitutional AI constraints, RLHF-aligned behavior boundaries, and system prompt integrity.
* Collaborate with cybersecurity teams on AI-specific threat modeling and vulnerability management.
* Maintain safety testing playbooks and document red-team findings with severity ratings and remediation recommendations.

Performance & Reliability Testing
  
  

* Define and execute load, stress, soak, and spike testing for AI-powered APIs, inference endpoints, and agent orchestration services.
* Measure and optimize end-to-end latency across RAG and agentic pipelines — from query to final response.
* Benchmark LLM inference throughput (tokens/second) and identify bottlenecks across model serving infrastructure.
* Test auto-scaling behavior of AI services under variable load conditions.
* Validate circuit breaker, retry, and fallback mechanisms in agentic and RAG systems for graceful degradation.
* Test vector database performance — query latency, index build time, and retrieval accuracy under high concurrency.
* Conduct cost efficiency analysis — measuring token consumption, API call costs, and infrastructure spend per agent task.
* Establish SLOs (Service Level Objectives) and SLAs for AI system availability, latency percentiles (P50, P95, P99), and error rates.
* Collaborate with MLOps teams to set up observability dashboards, monitoring alerts, and automated anomaly detection for production AI systems.
* Perform chaos engineering experiments to validate agent and RAG system resilience under infrastructure failures.

Domain Knowledge
  
  

* Deep understanding of RAG architecture patterns — naive RAG, advanced RAG, modular RAG.
* Solid grasp of agent design patterns: ReAct, Plan-and-Execute, Reflexion, MRKL, Mixture-of-Agents.
* Familiarity with AI safety and alignment principles (RLHF, Constitutional AI, guardrail layers).
* Knowledge of token economics, context management, and LLM cost optimization.
* Proficiency in performance engineering methodologies for distributed AI systems.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol) or similar agentic communication standards.
* Exposure to multi-modal agent testing (agents handling text, images, code, documents).
* Experience in regulated industries (banking, finance, healthcare) with strict compliance requirements.
* Familiarity with chaos engineering tools (Chaos Monkey, Gremlin, LitmusChaos).

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
* Master’s degree is a plus.

**Experience**

* 8+ years of experience in software or AI/ML quality engineering.
* 3+ years of hands-on experience with RAG systems, or Agentic AI.
* Proven experience building automated test frameworks for non-deterministic AI systems.
* Strong background in performance testing and AI safety/security assessments.

title: QA Engineer - Fresher
description:
**Job Description**
Job Description
  
  
QA Engineer – Fresher
  
  
**Company:**
Gway Tech Solutions Private Limited
  
  
**Department:**
Quality Assurance (QA)
  
  
**Experience:**
Fresher
  
  
**Employment Type:**
Full-Time
  
  

* Role Overview

Gway Tech Solutions Private Limited is looking for a detail-oriented, analytical, and enthusiastic
**QA Engineer – Fresher**
to join our ERP product development team.
  
  
GwayERP is a business management platform designed to support complex business operations through integrated modules and workflows. As we continue to develop and deploy GwayERP and other enterprise applications to an increasing number of customers, maintaining application quality, reliability, accuracy, and consistency is essential.
  
  
The selected candidate will work closely with developers, business analysts, and the technical team to understand requirements, validate application functionality, identify defects, verify fixes, and ensure that new developments do not negatively affect existing functionality.
  
  
This role provides an opportunity to learn and work on real-world enterprise applications, including ERP workflows, functional testing, API testing, database validation, regression testing, test documentation, and automation fundamentals.
  
  
We are looking for someone who can think logically, investigate problems, understand business requirements, and identify issues before they reach customers.
  
  
**The objective is to ensure that every delivered feature works correctly, meets its requirements, and provides a reliable experience for the end user.**
You are not expected to know every testing tool or methodology from day one. However, you must have a strong willingness to learn, investigate unfamiliar problems, understand application behaviour, and continuously improve your testing skills.
  
  
****Our QA Philosophy:****
Understand the Requirement → Identify Test Scenarios → Execute Tests → Report Defects → Verify Fixes → Prevent Regression → Improve Quality
  
  

* Key Responsibilities
* Requirement Understanding & Test Planning

Understand application requirements and translate them into practical test scenarios.
  
  
**Responsibilities Include:**

* Read and understand functional requirements.
* Understand user stories and acceptance criteria.
* Clarify unclear requirements with the relevant team members.
* Identify positive and negative test scenarios.
* Identify boundary conditions and exceptional cases.
* Prepare test cases and checklists.
* Identify dependencies between different application features.
* Understand the expected results before executing tests.
* Maintain test documentation.

The candidate should develop the ability to identify not only what should work, but also what could go wrong.
  
  

* Manual Testing

Perform manual testing of GwayERP and other enterprise applications.
  
  
**Responsibilities Include:**

* Functional testing.
* UI testing.
* Form validation testing.
* Input validation testing.
* Positive and negative testing.
* Boundary value testing.
* Exploratory testing.
* Integration testing.
* Smoke testing.
* Sanity testing.
* Basic compatibility testing.
* Error message validation.
* User workflow validation.

The candidate should verify that the application behaves correctly under normal and exceptional conditions.
  
  
Testing must cover both successful operations and scenarios where the application should reject invalid inputs or prevent incorrect actions.
  
  

* ERP Functional Testing

Develop a practical understanding of ERP applications and business workflows.
  
  
**GwayERP Includes Business Functions Such As:**

* CRM
* Sales
* Procurement
* Purchase
* Inventory
* Production and Manufacturing
* Engineering
* Quality
* Finance
* Services
* HRMS
* Reports
* Data Services
* Gate Management

The candidate will learn to validate workflows across relevant modules.
  
  
**Responsibilities Include:**

* Understanding how individual ERP modules operate.
* Validating business rules.
* Testing transaction workflows.
* Verifying master data and transaction data.
* Testing approval workflows.
* Validating role-based access.
* Checking calculations and totals.
* Testing status transitions.
* Verifying relationships between transactions.
* Testing relevant cross-module integrations.
* Identifying inconsistencies between expected and actual business behaviour.

For example, when testing an inventory transaction, the candidate should verify not only whether the transaction saves successfully, but also whether the resulting stock quantity and related transaction details are correct.
  
  
**The expectation is to understand the business process behind the feature, not merely check whether a button works.**

* Test Case Preparation & Execution

Prepare clear, structured, and reusable test cases.
  
  
**Responsibilities Include:**

* Writing test scenarios.
* Preparing step-by-step test cases.
* Defining expected results.
* Preparing test data.
* Executing test cases.
* Recording actual results.
* Documenting pass/fail status.
* Capturing screenshots or supporting evidence when necessary.
* Recording defects found during execution.
* Updating test cases when functionality changes.

Test cases should be clear enough for another QA engineer to understand and execute.
  
  

* Bug Identification & Defect Reporting

Identify application defects and communicate them clearly to the development team.
  
  
**Responsibilities Include:**

* Reproducing reported issues.
* Identifying the steps required to reproduce a defect.
* Recording expected and actual results.
* Capturing screenshots, screen recordings, logs, or other relevant evidence.
* Recording the affected module and environment.
* Identifying the severity and business impact of defects.
* Reporting defects through the designated tracking system.
* Providing additional information when developers investigate issues.
* Retesting fixes.
* Confirming whether the reported issue has been resolved.

A good defect report should help the developer understand the problem without unnecessary back-and-forth communication.
  
  
**The Candidate Should Learn The Difference Between:**

* Bug
* Enhancement
* Requirement clarification
* Environment issue
* Data issue
* Expected application behaviour
* Regression Testing

Regression testing is an important responsibility because ERP modules are interconnected.
  
  
When new features or bug fixes are introduced, existing functionality must continue to work correctly.
  
  
**Responsibilities Include:**

* Retesting affected functionality.
* Identifying related modules that may be impacted.
* Executing relevant existing test cases.
* Validating important business workflows.
* Checking for unintended side effects.
* Maintaining regression test cases.
* Supporting regression testing before releases.

The candidate should learn to identify the potential impact of a code change and select appropriate tests to validate it.
  
  
**A new feature is not considered successful if it breaks an existing business workflow.**

* API Testing

Learn to validate REST APIs used by GwayERP and other applications.
  
  
**Responsibilities Include:**

* Understanding HTTP methods.
* Testing GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, and DELETE requests as applicable.
* Understanding request headers and parameters.
* Validating request payloads.
* Checking response status codes.
* Validating response structures.
* Testing authentication and authorization.
* Testing invalid requests.
* Checking validation messages.
* Identifying API errors.
* Verifying API behaviour against requirements.

Candidates should learn to use tools such as Postman or similar API testing utilities.
  
  
The objective is to validate backend functionality independently of the user interface wherever possible.
  
  

* Database Validation

Develop basic skills in validating application data.
  
  
**Responsibilities Include:**

* Understanding database records.
* Performing basic MongoDB queries.
* Validating data created through application transactions.
* Checking whether updates are reflected correctly.
* Identifying missing or duplicate records.
* Validating data relationships.
* Checking transaction consistency.
* Investigating data-related defects.
* Supporting developers during database-related troubleshooting.

Basic knowledge of MongoDB is desirable, but candidates should be willing to learn it as part of the role.
  
  
Database access must always follow established permissions and security procedures. Production data must not be modified during testing without explicit authorization.
  
  

* UI & User Experience Testing

Validate the usability and consistency of application interfaces.
  
  
**Responsibilities Include:**

* Checking page layouts.
* Testing forms and input fields.
* Validating dropdowns and selection controls.
* Checking buttons and navigation.
* Verifying error messages.
* Checking mandatory field indicators.
* Validating field-level restrictions.
* Testing tables, filters, sorting, and pagination.
* Checking responsive layouts where applicable.
* Identifying overlapping elements and display issues.
* Testing supported browsers.
* Reporting usability problems that may affect business users.

The candidate should pay attention to small inconsistencies that could affect application usability.
  
  

* Cross-Module & Integration Testing

ERP applications contain interconnected modules, so testing must cover dependencies between them.
  
  
**Responsibilities Include:**

* Understanding module dependencies.
* Testing relevant end-to-end workflows.
* Verifying that data moves correctly between modules.
* Validating integrated transactions.
* Checking API integrations.
* Identifying inconsistencies between modules.
* Testing failure scenarios in integrated workflows.
* Verifying that errors are handled appropriately.

The candidate should learn to think beyond individual screens and validate the complete business process.
  
  

* Release & Deployment Validation

Work with developers and the DevOps team to validate application releases.
  
  
**Responsibilities Include:**

* Understanding the changes included in a release.
* Reviewing relevant test cases.
* Performing smoke testing after deployment.
* Verifying important application functionality.
* Validating configuration-dependent behaviour.
* Checking for deployment-related issues.
* Reporting release-blocking defects.
* Retesting fixes in the appropriate environment.
* Recording testing results.

The candidate should understand the difference between development, testing, staging, trial, and production environments.
  
  
Production testing must follow approved procedures and must not compromise customer data or live business operations.
  
  

* Test Data Management

Prepare and maintain suitable test data for different testing scenarios.
  
  
**Responsibilities Include:**

* Creating test records in approved environments.
* Preparing valid and invalid inputs.
* Maintaining reusable test datasets.
* Testing boundary conditions.
* Testing duplicate entries.
* Testing missing mandatory fields.
* Testing large or unusual input values.
* Preparing scenarios for different user roles.
* Ensuring test data is appropriate for the environment.

The candidate must follow data privacy and security requirements when handling customer information.
  
  

* Performance & Reliability Testing Fundamentals

Learn the fundamentals of application performance and reliability testing.
  
  
**Responsibilities Include:**

* Identifying slow application responses.
* Reporting long-running operations.
* Testing applications with representative data volumes where appropriate.
* Observing response times.
* Identifying obvious performance inconsistencies.
* Learning basic load and stress testing concepts.
* Using appropriate tools to investigate performance issues.
* Reporting reproducible performance problems.

Familiarity with tools such as Apache JMeter or k6 will be an advantage.
  
  
The candidate is not expected to be a performance testing specialist initially but should be willing to develop these skills as required.
  
  

* AI-Assisted Testing

**Using AI tools intelligently to improve testing productivity and coverage is an important expectation of this role.**
The candidate should learn to use AI tools to support:
  
  

* Understanding requirements.
* Identifying missing test scenarios.
* Generating test case ideas.
* Preparing positive and negative test cases.
* Identifying edge cases.
* Creating test data.
* Analysing error messages.
* Improving defect reports.
* Generating API test scenarios.
* Preparing test documentation.
* Exploring regression testing opportunities.
* Assisting with test automation.
* Summarizing testing results.

AI-generated test cases and analysis must be reviewed for accuracy and relevance before use.
  
  
The candidate must not blindly trust AI-generated outputs or upload confidential source code, credentials, customer data, or sensitive business information to unauthorized AI tools.
  
  
The objective is to use AI to improve testing accuracy, coverage, and speed without compromising data security.
  
  
**The expected approach is better testing in less time, not simply generating more test cases.**

* Test Automation Fundamentals

Develop an understanding of automated testing and gradually contribute to suitable automation activities.
  
  
**Responsibilities Include:**

* Learning the fundamentals of test automation.
* Identifying repetitive test scenarios suitable for automation.
* Understanding automated test scripts.
* Learning basic scripting where required.
* Supporting API test automation.
* Learning UI automation tools.
* Maintaining automated tests under guidance.
* Investigating automation failures.
* Understanding the difference between functional defects and test script failures.

Familiarity with Playwright, Cypress, or Selenium will be an advantage.
  
  
Prior automation experience is not mandatory for freshers, but a willingness to learn and practise is expected.
  
  

* Documentation & Quality Reporting

Maintain accurate and useful QA documentation.
  
  
**Responsibilities Include:**

* Preparing test plans where required.
* Maintaining test cases.
* Recording test execution results.
* Maintaining defect reports.
* Documenting regression scenarios.
* Recording retesting results.
* Preparing basic test summary reports.
* Maintaining evidence for important test cases.
* Updating documentation when requirements change.
* Communicating unresolved issues and testing risks.

The objective is to ensure that testing activities are traceable, repeatable, and easy for the team to understand.
  
  

* Working With Developers & Business Teams

Work closely with developers, business analysts, QA colleagues, and other relevant team members.
  
  
**Responsibilities Include:**

* Understanding requirements before testing.
* Clarifying expected application behaviour.
* Reporting defects with clear evidence.
* Discussing issues with developers.
* Retesting resolved defects.
* Participating in requirement discussions where appropriate.
* Providing feedback on testability and usability.
* Communicating testing progress.
* Identifying risks before a release.
* Supporting continuous improvement in application quality.

The candidate should communicate issues professionally and focus on identifying and resolving problems rather than assigning blame.
  
  

* Learning & Continuous Improvement

This position requires a strong self-learning mindset.
  
  
**The Candidate Is Expected To:**

* Learn testing methodologies.
* Understand software development fundamentals.
* Practise writing effective test cases.
* Learn API testing.
* Develop basic database testing skills.
* Understand ERP business workflows.
* Learn relevant testing tools.
* Explore AI-assisted testing.
* Learn automation fundamentals.
* Research unfamiliar issues.
* Improve defect reporting.
* Learn from feedback.
* Document useful findings.
* Continuously improve testing accuracy and efficiency.

We value the ability to learn, investigate, and apply knowledge more than familiarity with a long list of testing tools.
  
  

* Required Technical Skills

Testing Fundamentals
  
  

* Understanding of software testing concepts.
* Basic knowledge of functional testing.
* Understanding of positive and negative test cases.
* Basic knowledge of test scenarios and test cases.
* Understanding of defect reporting.
* Basic understanding of the software development lifecycle.

API Testing
  
  

* Basic understanding of REST APIs.
* Familiarity with HTTP methods and status codes.
* Willingness to learn Postman or similar tools.
* Basic understanding of request and response validation.

Database Testing
  
  

* Basic knowledge of databases.
* Understanding of data validation.
* Familiarity with MongoDB is an advantage.
* Willingness to learn basic database queries.

Development & Technical Fundamentals
  
  

* Basic understanding of web applications.
* Familiarity with browsers and developer tools.
* Basic knowledge of HTML, CSS, or JavaScript is an advantage.
* Familiarity with Git is desirable.
* Willingness to learn test automation.

AI & Productivity Tools
  
  

* Willingness to use AI tools for test design and analysis.
* Ability to review AI-generated outputs critically.
* Awareness of data privacy and security when using AI.
* Good to Have

Familiarity with any of the following will be an advantage:
  
  

* Postman
* Playwright
* Cypress
* Selenium
* Apache JMeter
* k6
* MongoDB
* Git/GitHub
* Jira or similar issue-tracking tools
* Test case management tools
* Basic SQL
* JavaScript or TypeScript
* API automation
* UI automation
* AI-assisted testing tools
* ERP or business management applications

Candidates are not expected to know every tool listed above.
  
  

* Eligibility & Experience

**Required**

* Fresh graduates or candidates with knowledge in software testing, QA.
* Basic understanding of software applications.
* Logical and analytical thinking.
* Good attention to detail.
* Ability to follow structured testing procedures.
* Clear written communication.
* Willingness to learn testing tools and methodologies.
* Interest in understanding business applications.
* Ability to investigate problems systematically.

**Preferred Educational Background**

* Computer Science.
* Information Technology.
* Software Engineering.
* Computer Applications.
* Other relevant technical disciplines.

Candidates from other educational backgrounds may also apply if they demonstrate suitable analytical ability and a genuine interest in software quality assurance.
  
  
Academic projects, internships, testing assignments, and practical exposure to software applications will be considered.
  
  

* What We Expect From You

You are not expected to know every testing tool when you join.
  
  
**However, We Expect You To:**

* Read requirements carefully.
* Think logically about possible failures.
* Test beyond the obvious scenarios.
* Document defects clearly.
* Verify fixes before closing defects.
* Communicate issues early.
* Take responsibility for assigned testing activities.
* Learn unfamiliar application workflows.
* Understand the business impact of defects.
* Use AI tools responsibly.
* Improve your testing skills continuously.
* Work collaboratively with developers and other team members.
* Maintain confidentiality when handling application and customer data.

A good QA engineer should be curious about how things work and equally curious about how they might fail.
  
  

* Growth Opportunity

This role is designed for a fresher who wants to build a career in software quality assurance and enterprise application testing.
  
  
**The Candidate Will Gain Practical Exposure To:**

* Manual testing.
* Functional testing.
* ERP workflow testing.
* API testing.
* Database validation.
* Regression testing.
* Integration testing.
* Release validation.
* Test documentation.
* AI-assisted testing.
* Test automation.
* Performance testing fundamentals.
* Production issue investigation.

As technical capability improves, the candidate will have opportunities to handle more complex testing scenarios and contribute to test automation and quality improvement initiatives.
  
  
**Potential Career Progression:**
**QA Engineer → QA Engineer (Experienced) → Senior QA Engineer → QA Automation Engineer / QA Specialist → QA Lead**
Progression will depend on demonstrated skills, performance, and readiness for greater responsibility.
  
  

* Performance Expectations

**The Candidate's Performance Will Be Evaluated Based On:**

* Accuracy of test execution.
* Quality of test cases.
* Ability to identify meaningful defects.
* Clarity of defect reports.

* Timely completion of assigned testing activities.
* Appropriate use of AI-assisted testing.
* Reduction in avoidable testing omissions.
* Improvement in technical knowledge.
* Collaboration with developers and business teams.
* Consistency in following QA procedures.

The objective is to develop a dependable QA professional who can identify defects early, validate business requirements accurately, and help prevent issues from reaching customers.
  
  
**Quality is not measured by the number of bugs reported alone, but by the ability to identify meaningful risks and help deliver reliable software.**

* The Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is curious, analytical, detail-oriented, and interested in understanding how software behaves in real-world business situations.
  
  
You should be willing to explore an application, understand its workflows, investigate unexpected results, prepare meaningful test cases, and communicate defects clearly.
  
  
You do not need to be an expert on your first day.
  
  
However, you should be willing to learn testing methodologies, understand ERP business processes, develop technical skills, use AI tools intelligently, and continuously improve your ability to identify issues.
  
  
**We Are Looking For Someone Who Thinks:**

**Soft Skills**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Good communication and collaboration abilities.
* Ability to work in Agile and team-oriented environments.
* Willingness to learn and adapt to new tools and technologies.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with ERP or enterprise applications testing.
* Exposure to performance testing tools such as JMeter (basic knowledge).
* Understanding data validation, integration testing, or data migration testing.
* Experience in test automation within cloud-based environments.

**Experience**
