title: Principal Virtualization Engineer
description:
**At Visteon, the work we do is both relevant and recognized**
—not just by our organization, but by our peers, by industry-leading brands, and by millions of drivers around the world.
**That’s YOUR work.**
**And, as a truly global technology leader in the mobility space, focused on building cross-functional AND
**cross-cultural**
teams, we connect you with people who help you grow.**
****So here, whatever we do is not a job. It’s a mission.**
As a multi-billion-dollar leader of disruptive change in the industry, we are shaping the future, while enabling a cleaner environment. No other industry offers more fast-paced change and opportunity. We are in the midst of a mobility revolution that will completely change the way we interact with our vehicles, reduce the number of car accidents and fatalities, and make the world a cleaner place.**
****Visteon is at the epicenter of this mobility revolution.****
**Two major trends in the automotive industry – the shift to electric vehicles and vehicles with autonomous safety technologies – have created unique opportunities for Visteon. We are the only automotive provider focused exclusively on cockpit electronics – the fastest-growing segment in the industry.**
**And our team is ready for YOU. To show the world what you can do.**
****Detailed description:****

* Develop and execute SIL test plans and test cases for embedded systems.
* Collaborate with software development teams to understand the architecture and interfaces.
* Develop the plant model to help evaluate the virtual SW.
* Optimize and enhance SIL environment and testing tools for improved efficiency.
* Participate in model, simulation, design reviews and provide feedback on potential risks and improvements.
* Ensure compliance with industry standards and best practices in testing and validation
* Define the entry and exit criteria for SIL, across levels of virtualization.
* Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
* Effective communication and teamwork abilities.

****Key Experience required:****

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Master’s preferred)
* 8-10+ years of experience in combination of Software Development, Modeling, simulation, virtualization and tests.
* Hands-on experience in AUTOSAR based SW architecture, including middleware.
* Hands-on experience in modeling tools, like MATLAB Simulink, Simscape , ASCET, System Desk, etc. (Extensive exp FMU’s, including on Co-Sim and Model exchange)
* Hands on experience on one or more of the following : VEOS, Silver, vVirtualTarget, ISOLAR EVE, QEMU. (Any tool migration experience would be an added advantage)
* Strong knowledge of Automation Framework Tools & Scripting Languages (Python, CAPL, Automation desk, etc.)
* Strong automotive domain knowledge (Cockpit electronics along with Battery management Systems preferred)
* Hands on experience with Linux, Docker - Containerization, KVM, VM's etc
* Expertise in across the levels of virtualization, from L1 to L4 and with both Open and closed loop simulation.
* Expertise in MIL/SIL setups preferred. PIL would be great value addition.
* Strong experience with Automotive buses such as CAN, LIN, Ethernet etc.,
* Strong experience with Test Management tools such as X-RAY, HP Quality Center, etc.,
* Experience in Agile/SCRUM Ceremonies
* Understanding or awareness of ASAM XiL

****More Good Reasons to Work for Visteon Focusing on the Future****
**Our company strategy focuses on leading the evolution of automotive digital cockpits and safety solutions. This strategy is driven by constant innovation, and you will support our efforts through your role. We are recognized across the industry for innovation. We have a strong book of business that is expected to drive future growth, along with a customer base that includes almost every automotive manufacturer in the world.**
****Company Culture****
**Working at Visteon is a journey in which our employees can develop their strengths and advance their careers while making a difference globally. Join us and help change the world and how we interact with our vehicles. Visteon is where the best technical talent creates the future. Learn more about our culture here.**
****About Visteon****
**Visteon is a global technology company serving the mobility industry, dedicated to creating a more enjoyable, connected and safe driving experience. The company’s platforms leverage proven, scalable hardware and software solutions that enable the digital, electric, and autonomous evolution of our global automotive customers. Visteon products align with key industry trends and include digital instrument clusters, displays, Android-based infotainment systems, domain controllers, advanced driver assistance systems and battery management systems. The company is headquartered in Van Buren Township, Michigan, and has approximately 10,000 employees at more than 40 facilities in 18 countries. Visteon reported sales of approximately $2.8 billion and booked $5.1 billion of new business in 2021.**

Responsible for system engineering, requirements management, integration, and validation of Connected Car Services for Full Hybrid Vehicle programs. description:
**Job Summary**
Serve as a Technical Lead for Genesys Cloud solutions within a hybrid work model applying deep expertise in quality monitoring speech analytics and APIs to optimize contact center operations in auto claims and property and casualty insurance. Drive high impact technical initiatives that improve customer experience operational efficiency and compliance for a global organization.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead end to end technical design and implementation of Genesys Cloud solutions to support complex contact center workflows for auto claims and property and casualty insurance operations.

* Show comfort working with enterprise change management and release processes ensuring that Genesys Cloud updates and API changes are deployed in a controlled and documented manner.

****Job Description****
The IT Application Support Analyst role is responsible for the end-to-end investigation and resolution of ERP incidents requiring deeper functional or technical expertise, including root-cause analysis, integration troubleshooting, solution validation, documentation, and effective escalation to Level 3 when required.
  
  
****Key Responsibilities/Areas Of Accountability****
**Incident investigation and resolution**

* Analyze ERP incidents escalated from Level 1.
* Identify root causes and provide functional or technical solutions/workarounds.
* Reproduce issues and distinguish between configuration, master data, integration, application, and infrastructure problems.

**Functional support**

* Provide expertise across assigned ERP modules and business processes.
* Troubleshoot transactional errors and incorrect system behavior.
* Assist users with complex process or application-related questions.

**Integration troubleshooting**

* Investigate failures between the ERP and connected applications.
* Analyze interfaces, error messages, batch jobs, queues, and data flows.
* Coordinate resolution with other application/support teams when the problem crosses system boundaries.

**Escalation to Level 3**

* Determine when an issue requires development, product expertise, infrastructure changes, or vendor intervention.
* Provide Level 3 with a complete analysis, including reproduction steps, logs, examples, expected versus actual results, and business impact.
* Validate the solution after Level 3 implementation.

**Problem management and root-cause analysis**

* Identify recurring incidents and underlying systemic problems.
* Lead or contribute to root-cause analysis.
* Recommend permanent corrective and preventive actions.

**Change and release support**

* Assess the impact of fixes, configuration changes, and ERP updates.
* Perform functional/system testing and coordinate business validation when appropriate.
* Support deployments and post-deployment verification.

**Monitoring and operational support**

* Monitor critical ERP processes, scheduled jobs, integrations, and interfaces.
* Investigate failures proactively where monitoring is available.
* Ensure critical business processes are restored within agreed service levels.

**Ticket and SLA management**

* Own assigned incidents through resolution rather than simply forwarding them.
* Prioritize according to severity and business impact.
* Maintain clear, accurate ticket documentation and regular communication with users.

**Knowledge management**

* Document solutions, known errors, troubleshooting procedures, and recurring issues.
* Create knowledge articles that enable Level 1 to resolve more incidents independently.
* Share knowledge with other ERP support team members.

**Business and IT coordination**

* Act as a bridge between business users and technical teams.
* Translate business symptoms into technical/functional requirements for specialists.
* Communicate technical findings in language understandable to business stakeholders.

****CRITICAL CAPABILITIES****

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* ERP Functional Expertise
* Strong understanding of core ERP processes and assigned functional areas (BaanIV, Infor LN, or Microsoft Dynamics AX 2012).
* Ability to understand how transactions flow across modules.
* Ability to distinguish process, configuration, master-data, and system issues.

**Advanced Troubleshooting & Root-Cause Analysis**

* Systematic investigation of complex incidents.
* Identify symptom vs. root cause.
* Analyze application errors, logs, jobs, interfaces, and transaction history.
* Develop and validate workarounds when immediate resolution is unavailable.

**Integration & End-to-End Process Understanding**

* Understand ERP interfaces with upstream and downstream applications.
* Trace transactions across systems.
* Determine where a failure occurred and which team/application owns it.
* Understand dependencies between ERP, middleware, databases, reporting, and external systems.

**Incident Ownership & Prioritization**

* Take ownership from escalation through resolution.
* Assess business impact, urgency, and priority.
* Drive resolution across multiple technical or functional teams.
* Maintain clear communication with impacted users and stakeholders.

**Technical Analysis**

* Ability to investigate application logs, batch processes, queues, interfaces, and error messages.
* Basic understanding of databases and data structures.
* Ability to perform data analysis and queries where appropriate.
* Understand enough of the ERP technical architecture to engage effectively with developers and infrastructure teams.

****Requirements****

* EDUCATION: Bachelor's Degree/College Diploma in a technical discipline (Engineering or IT related)
* EXPERIENCE: 3+ years of experience as an ERP application support or ERP analyst preferred.
* 3+ years of process improvement, data, or technology project experience would be a strong asset.
* 2+ years of experience working with BaanIV, Infor LN or Microsoft Dynamics AX 2012.

description:
**Company**
: IIC Group (Innovative Instruments & Controls)

**Location**
: Chennai (factory-based, with site visits as needed)

**Reports to**
: Managing Director / Head of Operations

**Experience**
: 8–12 years in LT, control and automation panel manufacturing, including at least 3 years leading a team

**Qualification**
: BE/B.Tech or Diploma in EEE, EIE or ECE

**Role Summary**

You will lead day-to-day production, testing and quality of MCC, PCC, VFD, APFC and PLC/automation panels. You make sure every panel leaves the shop floor on time, built to drawing, fully tested and documented. You will work as the link between Design, Stores/Logistics, Sales and the customer so production runs without rework or delays.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Production Management**

- Plan and run panel production schedules against order priorities and delivery commitments

- Lead and supervise wiremen, fitters and testing technicians, including allocating manpower and tracking productivity

- Make sure builds follow approved GA/schematic drawings, BOM and wiring standards

- Find bottlenecks, cut rework and improve cycle time and workmanship

- Enforce shop-floor safety, 5S and housekeeping

**VFD Testing, Troubleshooting & Commissioning**

- Carry out hands-on parameterisation, testing and troubleshooting of VFDs (Siemens, Schneider, ABB, Control Techniques, Danfoss, Delta, Mitsubishi or similar)

- Run motor-coupled and no-load testing, and check I/O, communication and protection functions

- Support site commissioning and resolve field issues when needed

**PLC Panel FAT & Testing**

- Prepare and run FAT procedures: I/O checks, network/communication tests (PROFINET, Modbus, Ethernet/IP), interlock and sequence simulation

- Lead customer and consultant FAT witness visits, and record and close punch points

- Carry out routine tests such as IR, HV and continuity, plus functional and power-on tests

**QC & Documentation**

- Prepare and maintain QC dossiers: inspection checklists, test reports, FAT protocols and reports, IR/HV records, calibration records and as-built markups

- Make sure panels comply with IEC 61439 / IS 8623, IEC 60204-1 and customer specifications

- Maintain NCR/CAPA records and support ISO quality system requirements

**Cross-Functional Coordination**

- Design: clarify drawings, feed back on manufacturability and control revisions

- Purchase/Stores/Logistics: track material readiness, shortages, dispatch planning, packing and documents

- Sales: confirm delivery dates, technical deviations and change orders

- Customer: handle progress updates, inspection scheduling, query resolution and handover

**Other**

- Any other responsibilities assigned by management in line with business needs

**Skills & Competencies**

- Strong hands-on knowledge of VFDs, PLCs (Siemens S7-1200/1500 preferred), HMIs and switchgear

- Able to read and interpret electrical schematics, GA drawings and BOMs

- Sound knowledge of panel testing practice and relevant standards

- Proven ability to lead a shop-floor team and meet deadlines

- Good communication skills in English and Tamil, with confidence dealing with customers and consultants

- Working knowledge of MS Excel/Office; exposure to EPLAN or AutoCAD Electrical is a plus

**Preferred**

- Experience with OEM or system-integrator panel shops serving pharma, F&B, water/wastewater or oil & gas

- Exposure to customer FATs witnessed by third-party inspectors

**Compensation**
: Competitive, based on experience

title: Engineer II, Supplier Quality
description:
**Description**
Enphase Energy is a global energy technology company and a leading provider of solar, battery, and electric vehicle charging products. Founded in 2006, our innovative microinverter technology revolutionized solar power, making it a safer, more reliable, and scalable energy source. Today, the Enphase Energy System enables users to make, use, save, and sell their own power. Enphase is also one of the most successful and innovative clean energy companies in the world, with more than 80 million products shipped across 160 countries.
  
  
Join our dynamic teams designing and developing next-gen energy technologies and help drive a sustainable future!
  
  
**Must be available to work on-site at Salcomp, Chennai, India 5 days per week.**
**About The Role**

* APQP/PPAP Administration: Manage the submission and review process of Advanced Product Quality Planning (APQP) and Production Part Approval Process (PPAP) documents.
* Systemic Solutions Support: Act as a key contributor and System Administrator for the deployment of new electronic tools for supplier quality management.
* Supplier Data compliance: Audit suppliers supporting quality documents to ensure they meet Enphase requirements before final SQE approval.

+ Ensure that all suppliers have completed the qualification steps before releasing them to production by developing dashboard to help SQEs track suppliers documentation.

* Process Improvement: Identify GAPs in the Quality documentation and propose fixes and improvements.
* Data-Driven Quality Engineering:

+ Develop and automate quality dashboards to track Supplier DPPM, Yield, and Cost of Poor Quality (CoPQ).

* Supplier Audits & Corrective Actions: Conduct on-site process audits and lead the 8D/SCAR process, ensuring suppliers implement data-verified root cause closures.
* Operational Flexibility: Exhibit high flexibility to adapt to shifting roles and schedules to align with Enphase’s global operations.
* Incoming Quality Control (IQC): Oversee the inspection of incoming electronic components (PCBA, magnetic materials) and mechanical parts provided by CM sub-suppliers to ensure they meet specifications.
* Process Verification: Ensure the Supplier is following the approved Control Plan.
* NPI Support: Participate in New Product Introduction (NPI) stages helping SQEs to track the completion of Line Qualification Dashboard, FAI (First Article Inspection) and PPAP (Production Part Approval Process) documentation and assisting in pilot production builds.

**Who you are and What you bring**

* Education: College studies in mechanical, Electrical, Industrial Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent relevant experience.
* Experience: 2+ years of experience, preferably Supplier Quality and Data analytics.
* Technical Core:

+ Basic knowledge in Quality Core Tools: APQP, PPAP, MSA, SPC, QCP and FMEA.
+ Strong proficiency in Data Analytics and visualization tools.

* Mindset: Strong analytical mindset, high attention to detail, and the ability to act as a "superuser" or admin for new software tools.
* Standards: Desirable basic knowledge of IPC-A-610 (acceptability of electronic assemblies).
* Environment: Frequently involves a mix of professional office settings, cleanrooms/labs, and active construction or fabrication sites.
* Physical Demands: May require standing for long periods, few times lifting to 35–60 pounds.
* Desired Skills:

+ Exposure to contract manufacturing partnership.
+ Working experience in manufacturing industry and data collection.
+ A clear desire to grow into a Supplier Quality Engineer (SQA) role.

* Work location: Salcomp, Chennai, India (Onsite).
* Travel: Travels to supplier facilities (up to 10-20%).

title: Technical Support Engineer
description:
**About Us**

Effy (Rayles and Roobie Technologies Pvt. Ltd.) is a Chennai-based custom software development company and Freshworks Premium System Integration Partner, building integrations, middleware/APIs, and marketplace apps for clients across fintech, retail, media, and legal sectors. This role owns quality assurance across all client integrations and Freshworks marketplace apps and also acts as the technical point of contact for support requests raised by clients, customers, and partners making this a hybrid QA and technical support/customer success role.

**About the Role:**

We are looking for a customer-focused and technically inclined Technical Support Engineer to join our team. This role is ideal for freshers and candidates with up to 2 years of experience who have good communication skills, an interest in troubleshooting technical issues, and a willingness to learn.

You will be responsible for handling customer support tickets, participating in customer calls, performing initial debugging, and providing timely responses to customer queries. As we work with customers across the UK and US, strong English communication skills are essential.

Knowledge transfer and guidance will be provided to help you understand our applications and handle customer issues independently.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Handle customer support tickets, investigate reported issues, and provide timely responses and updates.
* Attend customer calls and communicate professionally with customers across the UK and US.
* Perform L1 troubleshooting and initial debugging of application-related issues.
* Test APIs using tools such as Postman and validate API requests and responses.
* Use Browser Developer Tools to inspect network requests, analyze console errors, and troubleshoot application issues.
* Explain technical issues and troubleshooting steps clearly to both technical and non-technical customers.
* Document investigation findings, error messages, logs, and troubleshooting steps in support tickets.
* Escalate complex issues to the development team with relevant technical details.
* Follow up on open tickets and coordinate with internal teams to ensure timely resolution.
* Learn our products and applications through internal knowledge-transfer sessions and apply the knowledge to customer support activities.

**Required Skills:**

* Good verbal and written English communication skills.
* Confidence in communicating with international customers.
* Basic understanding of REST APIs, HTTP methods, status codes, and JSON.
* Familiarity with API testing tools such as Postman.
* Basic knowledge of Browser Developer Tools, especially Console and Network tabs.
* Good analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to understand technical problems and explain them in simple terms.
* Good documentation, ticket management, and follow-up skills.

**Preferred Skills:**

* Basic knowledge of JavaScript or any scripting knowledge.
* Familiarity with HTML, CSS, and web applications.
* Understanding of client-server architecture and API integrations.
* Internship, academic project, or prior experience in technical support or application support is an added advantage.

**Additional Preferred Skills - AI Tools**

* Basic familiarity with AI tools such as ChatGPT (GPT), Claude or Cursor etc.
* Ability to use AI tools to assist with technical troubleshooting, error analysis, understanding API responses, and identifying potential solutions.
* Willingness to learn and leverage AI-powered tools to improve productivity and problem-solving efficiency.
* Basic understanding of how to use AI tools to analyze code snippets, browser console errors, and technical documentation.



**Who Can Apply?**

* Freshers and candidates with
  **0–2 years of experience**
  .
* Candidates interested in technical support, application troubleshooting, and API testing.
* Individuals with strong communication skills and a willingness to learn new technologies.

If you enjoy solving problems, helping customers, and working with technology, we'd love to hear from you!

title: Engineer - Controls Engineering
description:
**Job Description Summary**
Systems Engineering ist eine funktionsübergreifende technische Disziplin, die sich auf einen Ansatz, eine Denkweise und einen Prozess konzentriert. Alle Tätigkeiten, die sowohl die geschäftlichen als auch die technischen Anforderungen der Kunden berücksichtigen, mit dem Ziel, ein Qualitätsprodukt bereitzustellen, das die Anforderungen der Benutzer erfüllt. Die Disziplin zur Umsetzung eines soliden Prozesses zum Entwerfen, Erstellen und Optimieren von Systemen, der aus der Identifizierung und Quantifizierung von Systemanforderungen, der Erstellung alternativer Systementwurfskonzepte, der Durchführung von Design-Trade-off-Studien, der Auswahl und Implementierung der besten Entwürfe und der Überprüfung der Tatsache besteht, dass das Design ordnungsgemäß integriert ist und ausgeführt wird. Prozess, der vom Konzept über die Produktion bis zum Betrieb verläuft.
  
  
Beeinflusst die Qualität der eigenen Arbeit und der Arbeit anderer im Team.Führt betriebliche/technische Standardaufgaben aus, die in der Regel Anweisungen und Arbeitsabläufen unterliegen.Möglicherweise besteht Spielraum, um die Reihenfolge zu ändern und Aufgaben/Pflichten basierend auf sich ändernden Arbeitssituationen zu erledigen.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Rollen und Verantwortlichkeiten**

* Führt Komponenten- und Produktintegration durch. Alle Aktivitäten, die mehrere Komponenten und Produkte umfassen und sich mit der Integration für maximale Leistung und Bedienbarkeit befassen. Verwaltet Produkt- und Systemanforderungen, Spezifikationen und den Datenfluss. Führt Validierungs- und Verifizierungsaktivitäten für das gesamte Produkt/System durch, einschließlich Tests auf Systemebene. Verantwortlich für die Definition der Produktanforderungen für das Modul/die Komponente/Subunternehmer und Partnerteams. Verwaltet die Schnittstelle zwischen Komponenten und Ausführungsorganisationen. Verantwortlich für das Vorantreiben von CTQ/Risk-Trades innerhalb der Teams, die die Komponenten entwerfen. Verwaltet die Gesamtproduktkonfiguration und das Konfigurationssteuerungssystem.
* Erweiterung der Kenntnisse der eigenen technischen Disziplin zur Umsetzung von Richtlinien/Strategien.Kann Support-Rollen mit spezialisiertem technischem Wissensgebiet beinhalten; laufender Erwerb von Kenntnissen und Fähigkeiten auf höherem Niveau.
* Grundlegendes Verständnis der wichtigsten Geschäftstreiber; nutzt dieses Verständnis, um eigene Arbeit zu leisten.Gute Kenntnisse darüber, wie sich die Arbeit des eigenen Teams in andere Teams integriert und zum Bereich beiträgt.
* Kann eine gewisse Autonomie besitzen, um Entscheidungen innerhalb eines definierten Rahmens zu treffen.Löst Probleme in Situationen, in denen gute technische Kenntnisse und Urteilsvermögen im Rahmen festgelegter Verfahren erforderlich sind.Konsultiert hochrangigere Teammitglieder zu Problemen außerhalb definierter Anweisungen/Parameter.
* Eine Stelle auf diesem Niveau erfordert gute zwischenmenschliche Fähigkeiten und kann notwendig sein, um ein Junior-Team zu führen.Entwickelt für kundenorientierte Rollen starke Kundenbeziehungen und dient als Schnittstelle zwischen Kunden und GE Vernova.Erklärt anderen technische Informationen.

**Grundqualifikationen**

* Diese Rolle erfordert grundlegende Erfahrung . Der Wissensstand ist vergleichbar mit einem Bachelor-Abschluss einer akkreditierten Universität oder Hochschule (oder einem Abitur mit entsprechender Erfahrung).

**Gewünschte Eigenschaften**

* Sehr gute mündliche und schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten. Ausgeprägte Sozialkompetenz und Führungsqualitäten. Fähigkeit, selbständig zu arbeiten. Starke Fähigkeiten zur Problemlösung.Hinweis:Um die Einwanderungsbestimmungen der USA und andere gesetzliche Anforderungen zu erfüllen, muss die Mindestanzahl der Jahre an Erfahrung angegeben werden, die für eine Tätigkeit in den USA erforderlich sind.Für Rollen außerhalb der USA sollten sich die JDs auf das für die Rolle erforderliche inhaltliche Erfahrungsniveau konzentrieren, um die Einhaltung der geltenden Rechtsvorschriften zu gewährleisten, und eine Mindestanzahl von Jahren sollte NICHT verwendet werden.Diese Stellenbeschreibung soll einen allgemeinen Leitfaden für die Rolle liefern.Sie soll jedoch nicht die von jedem Mitarbeiter gemäß dem jeweiligen Arbeitsvertrag und/oder gemäß einer anderweitigen Vereinbarung zwischen einem Mitarbeiter und seinem Vorgesetzten geforderten Pflichten ändern oder anderweitig einzuschränken/erweitern.

******Additional Information******
**Relocation Assistance Provided:**
Yes

title: Technical Lead, Software Development
description:
**Company Overview**
KLA is a global leader in diversified electronics for the semiconductor manufacturing ecosystem. Virtually every electronic device in the world is produced using our technologies. No laptop, smartphone, wearable device, voice-controlled gadget, flexible screen, VR device or smart car would have made it into your hands without us. KLA invents systems and solutions for the manufacturing of wafers and reticles, integrated circuits, packaging, printed circuit boards and flat panel displays. The innovative ideas and devices that are advancing humanity all begin with inspiration, research and development. KLA focuses more than average on innovation and we invest 15% of sales back into R&D. Our expert teams of physicists, engineers, data scientists and problem-solvers work together with the world’s leading technology providers to accelerate the delivery of tomorrow’s electronic devices. Life here is exciting and our teams thrive on tackling really hard problems. There is never a dull moment with us.
  
  
**Group/Division**
With over 40 years of semiconductor process control experience, chipmakers around the globe rely on KLA to ensure that their fabs ramp next-generation devices to volume production quickly and cost-effectively. Enabling the movement towards advanced chip design, KLA's Global Products Group (GPG), which is responsible for creating all of KLA’s metrology and inspection products, is looking for the best and the brightest research scientist, software engineers, application development engineers, and senior product technology process engineers. The Optical Metrology Division products are used for optical overlay metrology. The portfolio of products includes unique solution packages which are based on hardware and software systems to enhance yield and effectiveness. As a world leader in its field of expertise, the division's products are the most advanced in performance (measurement accuracy of nanometers and below), reliability, ease of use and compatibility with other KLA's products. KLA (Israel) controls over 80% of the world market sales in its field, and its products are used by every major semiconductor manufacturer around the world. KLA Israel is located in the Migdal Haemek Industrial Park.
  
  
**Job Description/Preferred Qualifications**
**Essential Responsibilities:**

* Acquire and demonstrate technical knowledge of OMD product software.
* Perform requirements analysis, software design, development and unit testing
* Participate in requirements definition and review process. Provide Technical assessment of the impact of any changes to product requirements.
* Providing technical expertise to the estimation process as input to the project plan
* Acquire knowledge of key use cases in Optical Metrology
* Follow KLA defined software development processes (CMM)
* Understand and make changes to existing software.
* In conjunction with the technical lead, highlights, reviews and mitigates technical risks
* Contributes to the continued improvement of the organization's development procedures, by looking for opportunities for improvement and proposing ideas for solution.
* Ensuring that detailed designs, code, and unit tests, are consistent, robust, future-proof and scalable.

**Minimum Qualifications**
Qualifications/Requirements:
  
  

* Required: BE/BS/BTech degree with 4 or more years of SW experience.
* Required: Strong in programming fundamentals, C++, C#
* Required: Thorough knowledge of SDLC and software engineering
* Required: Experience in analysis, design, development and unit testing
* Required: Must be able to interact and communicate with all levels of staff and project management in both the business and the technical areas, with the ability to keep discussions at the appropriate level of abstraction.
* Required: Possess excellent analytical, problem solving, organizational, interpersonal, and motivational skills, with the ability to move cleanly from theoretical to implementation thinking.
* Required: Willingness to travel to Israel, US and other customer places on short assignments.
* Optional: Knowledge of KLA specific or general semiconductor domain

*KLA is proud to be an equal opportunity employer*

title: Quality Assurance Engineer
description:
**About the role**

Hyring is hiring a QA Engineer to own the quality of our product from start to finish. You'll test new features by hand, build and maintain Playwright test suites, and use AI tools to make testing faster and smarter.

You'll work closely with developers and product managers. Your job is to catch issues early, so each release is fast and dependable.

**Key responsibilities**

**Manual testing**

* Review requirements and user stories, then write clear test plans and test cases
* Run functional, regression, exploratory, usability and cross-browser tests
* Log bugs with clear steps to reproduce, then track them until they're fixed and verified

**Automated testing**

* Design, build and maintain end-to-end UI and API test suites using Playwright
* Add automated tests to the CI/CD pipeline so they run on every build and release
* Keep tests stable and fast by fixing flaky tests and keeping test data under control

**AI automation**

* Use AI tools to generate test cases, test data and test scripts faster
* Test our AI-powered features for accuracy, consistency and edge cases
* Find repetitive QA work and automate it with AI agents or scripts

**Quality ownership**

* Make the release go/no-go call on quality alongside the engineering team
* Track and report quality metrics such as test coverage, defect leakage and pass rates
* Push for better testing practices across the team

**Requirements**

* 2+ years of experience in software QA, covering both manual and automated testing
* Hands-on experience with Playwright, using TypeScript/JavaScript or Python
* Solid grasp of QA methods, the SDLC/STLC and Agile/Scrum
* Experience testing REST APIs with Postman or Playwright's API testing
* Has used AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude or GitHub Copilot to speed up QA work
* Experience with Git and CI/CD tools such as GitHub Actions or Jenkins
* Experience with bug tracking and test management tools such as Jira or TestRail
* Sharp eye for detail and clear written communication

title: ELN/LIMS configurations expert
description:
**Company Description**
DigAIT is a scientific technology and consulting partner that supports chemical and life sciences organizations in accelerating digital transformation across research, development, laboratory, manufacturing, and operations. The company combines AI, IT, scientific data, and deep domain expertise to design and implement digital solutions that make scientific processes more connected and data-driven. Its capabilities span process modeling, laboratory and manufacturing solutions, data analytics, business intelligence, and advanced AI technologies, including machine learning and generative AI. DigAIT works across the full transformation journey—from assessing current processes to implementing ELN/LIMS, integrating data, and enabling scalable analytics and AI. The team is experienced with leading platforms and tools such as LIMS, ELN, MES, ERP, SAP Signavio, BPMN, Power BI, Tableau, AWS, Azure, Python, and modern AI/LLM platforms.

**Role Description**
For Client based in Europe, we are looking for a ELN/LIMS configurations expert. This role based will be in Chennai, structured as a hybrid position that combines on-site work with some work-from-home flexibility. You will connect lab users, data science teams, and IT, ensuring that experimental data is captured in a structured, high-quality, and ML-ready form. The role combines hands-on configuration, product ownership, roll-out coordination for targeted labs and sites, and IT operations.

**Key responsibilities:**

1. Configurations and trainings

* Work with lab colleagues to design and configure workflows, data uploaders, templates, and master data especially related to formulation development process (materials, formulations, raw materials, test methods, properties, units)
* Translate lab processes in chemistry and material development into robust platform configurations
* Train users, support onboarding, and drive adoption

2. Product management

* Collect, prioritize, and manage requirements from business stakeholders
* Maintain the product backlog and roadmap, and deliver in an agile (Scrum) setup
* Run sprint planning, reviews, and stakeholder communication
* Manage releases, change requests, and configuration testing/validation

3. Integrations and IT operations

* Coordinate the development of integrations between the ELN and other systems (LIMS, ERP, PLM, instruments/CDS, data lakes, analytics/ML platforms) via APIs and interfaces
* Handle incident and problem management, second-level support, and vendor coordination
* Maintain knowledge documentation (configuration specs, SOPs, user guides, FAQs)

4. Roll-out and adoption coordination

* Coordinate roll-out activities end-to-end for specific smaller labs or sites (e.g., HTE lab, a particular site roll-out), building on the platform already established in the larger labs
* Reuse and adapt existing configurations, templates, and master data from the larger labs, and identify only the lab-specific extensions needed (e.g., HTE-specific workflows, uploaders, instrument interfaces)
* Define roll-out plans, timelines, and milestones together with the respective lab leads, IT, and data science teams
* Manage change and communication: stakeholder updates, training, user onboarding, and feedback loops
* Track adoption and roll-out KPIs (e.g., active users, workflow usage, open issues) and hand over to operations with complete documentation and support processes

5. Data governance

* Work with ML/data science teams to define rules for good data management (naming conventions, ontologies, mandatory fields, units, metadata)

**Qualifications**

* PhD or master’s degree in a relevant field such as Material science, Chemistry, physics or a related discipline is preferred.
* Experience with other ELN/LIMS/R&D platforms
  in chemical or life sciences laboratories including workflow design and data model configuration
  (Preferably Formulation data related experience). With PhD a minimum for 2-3 working experience is required and with Masters a minimum of 7-8 years working experience in required.
* Strong knowledge of application integration (REST APIs, data pipelines, SSO/identity, interfaces between lab and enterprise systems)
* Experience with Scrum/agile, backlog management, and stakeholder prioritization. Certifications such as Scrum Master/PSPO, ITIL, or relevant vendor certifications
* Experience with ITIL-based incident/change management
* Candidates should possess clear Communication skills to collaborate with scientists, IT teams, and business stakeholders and to document configurations and processes.
* Good familiarity with data science and ML concepts: data preparation, feature/data requirements, FAIR principles, data modeling
* Ability to work in a hybrid setup in Chennai, manage priorities independently, and adapt to evolving project requirements and technologies.

title: Engineer II, System validation Test - Insight QA
description:
**About The Role**
We are looking for an Engineer II in System Validation Testing with 3 to 5 years of experience to join our cloud network management quality engineering team. The role focuses on hands-on testing of a cloud-hosted platform used to onboard, configure, monitor and manage networking devices such as access points, switches and routers.
  
  
The engineer will work with senior QA engineers, developers and product teams to understand requirements, design and execute tests, automate repeatable workflows, investigate failures and contribute to reliable releases across the device, network, cloud, API and web or mobile application layers.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Cloud Network Management Testing
  
  

* Understand feature requirements and expected customer workflows for cloud-managed access points, switches and routers.
* Test device onboarding, discovery, provisioning, configuration and removal workflows.
* Validate device-to-cloud communication, cloud-to-device operations and configuration synchronization.
* Test device status, statistics, alerts, notifications and basic remote-management workflows.
* Validate firmware upgrade, reconnect, recovery and factory-reset scenarios under guidance.
* Execute tests across common LAN, WAN, Wi-Fi and multi-device network setups.

Test Planning and Execution
  
  

* Review user stories, acceptance criteria and functional specifications with the QA team.
* Create and maintain clear test scenarios and test cases covering positive, negative, boundary and recovery conditions.
* Prepare test data and configure required devices, accounts, subscriptions and environments.
* Execute functional, integration, system, regression, compatibility and end-to-end tests.
* Record results accurately, report coverage gaps and escalate blockers early.
* Retest resolved defects and run focused regression for impacted workflows.

API Cloud and Data Validation
  
  

* Test REST APIs using tools such as Postman and automation libraries.
* Validate request and response data, status codes, authentication, authorization and error handling.
* Verify consistency across APIs, backend services, database records and user interfaces.
* Test asynchronous operations, events and notifications with support from senior engineers.
* Use AWS logs, dashboards and application telemetry to investigate test failures.
* Perform smoke and regression validation in QA and staging environments.

Networking and Troubleshooting
  
  

* Apply networking fundamentals including TCP/IP, IPv4 and IPv6, DHCP, DNS, ARP, ICMP, HTTP and HTTPS, VLANs, routing, switching, NAT, LAN, WAN and Wi-Fi.
* Use ping, traceroute, nslookup or dig, iperf, browser developer tools and device or cloud logs during troubleshooting.
* Capture and perform basic analysis of network traffic using Wireshark or tcpdump.
* Isolate whether a failure is related to the device, network, cloud service, API, backend or application layer, and involve the appropriate team.

Test Automation
  
  

* Develop and maintain Python-based automation for APIs, device workflows and regression scenarios.
* Create or update UI automation using Playwright, Selenium or an equivalent framework.
* Follow existing framework standards and build reusable, readable and maintainable test components.
* Analyze automation failures, distinguish product defects from script or environment issues and fix tests within assigned scope.
* Run automated suites through CI/CD pipelines and report failures with supporting evidence.
* Identify stable, repetitive manual scenarios suitable for automation.

Defect Management and Team Collaboration
  
  

* Log clear defects with reproducible steps, expected and actual behavior, logs, screenshots, API traces and packet captures when applicable.
* Participate in defect triage, daily stand-ups, sprint planning and test-status discussions.
* Collaborate with software, cloud, firmware, networking and mobile teams to reproduce and resolve issues.
* Track assigned defects through retest and closure and communicate risks or delays promptly.
* Maintain test cases, automation and technical notes in the agreed repositories and tools.

Release and Production Support
  
  

* Support release regression, production smoke testing and post-deployment validation as assigned.
* Verify critical customer workflows after deployments and provide accurate test status to the QA lead.
* Assist with reproducing customer-reported or production issues in controlled environments.
* Contribute new regression tests for escaped defects and recurring failure patterns.

**Required Qualifications**

* 3 to 5 years of software QA or system validation experience.
* Hands-on experience in functional, integration, regression and end-to-end testing.
* Working knowledge of TCP/IP and core networking concepts.
* Experience testing REST APIs and interpreting JSON request and response data.
* Programming or test-automation experience using Python.
* Exposure to UI automation using Playwright, Selenium or an equivalent tool.
* Ability to analyze logs, reproduce issues and write clear defect reports.
* Experience using Git and working with CI/CD test execution.
* Good written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work in a cross-functional team.
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, Electronics, Telecommunications or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience testing cloud-managed networking or network management platforms.
* Hands-on exposure to access points, switches, routers or Wi-Fi test environments.
* Familiarity with AWS services, microservices, Docker or Kubernetes.
* Experience with Wireshark, tcpdump and basic packet analysis.
* Exposure to mobile application testing, performance testing or API security testing.
* Awareness of Wi-Fi 5, Wi-Fi 6, Wi-Fi 6E or Wi-Fi 7 concepts.
* Responsible use of AI-assisted engineering tools such as ChatGPT, Claude or GitHub Copilot for test design, automation, debugging or log analysis.

title: Product Test Consultant
description:
**Job Summary**
Serve as a senior product test consultant specializing in Facets claims and benefit configuration for healthcare payer and provider solutions in a hybrid work model. Apply deep hands on experience to validate complex configurations optimize claims processing accuracy and ensure system reliability and compliance. Collaborate closely with cross functional teams to deliver robust high quality Facets implementations that improve member and provider experiences while supporting enterprise scale o
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Drive comprehensive test strategy planning for Facets modules focused on claims adjudication and benefit configuration to ensure end to end coverage across core healthcare payer and provider use cases.
* Design detailed test scenarios and data sets for Facets claims processing including complex benefit rules and provider contract variations to validate accurate outcomes in high volume production environments.
* Execute functional and integration testing on Facets claims workflows to verify proper configuration of benefits accumulators pricing logic and provider networks while minimizing defects reaching production.
* Analyze Facets configuration tables and rule sets to identify potential gaps or conflicts in benefit designs and claims edits and propose corrective changes that improve operational efficiency.
* Collaborate with business analysts configuration teams and operations stakeholders to translate payer and provider business requirements into testable Facets scenarios that reflect real world claim patterns.
* Perform root cause analysis on defects identified in Facets claims and benefit configuration and document findings in clear test artifacts that enable targeted remediation and future prevention.
* Validate interoperability between Facets and downstream systems such as financial reporting data warehouses and provider portals to ensure claims and benefit data integrity across the ecosystem.
* Apply healthcare payer and provider domain expertise to evaluate the impact of new benefit designs regulatory mandates and product changes on Facets test coverage and regression suites.
* Create and maintain reusable test assets including regression packs test data libraries and execution checklists tailored to Facets claims and benefits modules to support continuous delivery.
* Coordinate test execution in a hybrid work environment ensuring effective communication of progress risks and dependencies across onsite and remote stakeholders during day shift operations.
* Provide mentoring and guidance to peers and junior testers on Facets configuration concepts claims adjudication flows and best practices for healthcare product testing while promoting quality ownership.
* Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives by assessing test process performance proposing optimization opportunities and supporting adoption of automation where feasible in Facets testing.
* Document clear and concise test results and business impact summaries highlighting improvements in claim accuracy benefit interpretation and provider satisfaction driven by high quality configuration validation.

**Qualifications**

* Leverage extensive experience of nine to twelve years in product testing with a strong focus on healthcare payer and provider domains to interpret complex requirements and design robust Facets test approaches.
* Apply expert proficiency in Facets claims functionality to validate claim adjudication business rules pricing logic and edits ensuring alignment with contractual and regulatory expectations.
* Utilize advanced knowledge of Facets benefit configuration including benefit plans accumulators and eligibility constructs to verify that configured products support diverse member coverage scenarios.
* Demonstrate hands on experience across broader Facets platform capabilities such as membership billing and provider data to ensure holistic validation of integrated health plan operations.
* Use deep domain knowledge in provider networks reimbursement models and contract structures to assess how Facets configurations impact provider claim outcomes and operational workflows.
* Employ strong understanding of payer business processes including enrollment benefits administration and claims lifecycle management to design tests that reflect real health plan operations.
* Apply familiarity with hybrid work practices and day shift collaboration models to maintain effective stakeholder engagement clear communication and consistent delivery of test commitments.

title: Hardware Validation Engineer
description:
**Company Brief**

Planys is a deep-tech company developing mission-critical robotic and digital systems for defence and strategic infrastructure. The company designs and builds unmanned systems and advanced sensing solutions across underwater, maritime, and land domains, with a strong focus on naval, coast guard, and army applications. Planys is actively engaged in the development of Unmanned Underwater Vehicles (UUVs) ranging from small to extra-large platforms, along with ruggedised electronic and digital systems for armoured vehicles.

Leveraging its strong foundation in marine robotics, underwater inspection, and non-destructive evaluation (NDT), Planys integrates defence-grade electronics, sensing, and data analytics to deliver highreliability systems suitable for harsh operational environments. The company combines platform engineering, payload integration, and AI-enabled digital analytics to support situational awareness, asset integrity assessment, and data-driven decision-making for defence forces and strategic asset operators.

Planys, globally recognised for strategic infrastructure solutions, is now focused on creating a strong and enduring presence in the defence sector, delivering indigenous unmanned and digital systems for the Army, Navy, and Coast Guard. (Website: www.planystech.com)

**Key Responsibilities**

* Integrate, validate, and test electrical and electronic subsystems for autonomous and defence-grade platforms.
* Plan and execute system integration, functional validation, and qualification testing.
* Perform environmental and reliability testing, including shock, vibration, temperature, humidity, insulation resistance, and environmental stress testing.
* Execute compliance testing in accordance with applicable defence standards such as
  **MIL-STD-810**
  ,
  **MIL-STD-461**
  , and related specifications.
* Perform electrical validation activities including power-up testing, wiring verification, continuity checks, insulation resistance (IR) testing, and signal integrity verification.
* Validate PCB assemblies, cable harnesses, connectors, grounding, shielding, and electrical interfaces to ensure robustness in harsh operating environments.
* Test and troubleshoot communication interfaces including
  **CAN, RS-485, Ethernet**
  , and other embedded sensor networks.
* Investigate test failures, perform root cause analysis (RCA), and implement corrective and preventive actions.
* Prepare and maintain detailed test procedures, reports, qualification records, compliance documentation, and issue trackers.
* Collaborate closely with Mechanical, Electrical, Embedded, Systems, Manufacturing, and Field Engineering teams to improve product reliability and manufacturability.
* Support product certification activities and coordinate with external test laboratories and certification agencies.
* Own the complete validation lifecycle from component-level verification through subsystem integration, system qualification, and field release.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics & Communication Engineering, Instrumentation Engineering, or a related discipline.
* 2–5 years of experience in electrical system integration, validation, testing, or qualification.
* Strong understanding of electrical schematics, wiring, connectors, PCB assemblies, and embedded electronic systems.
* Hands-on experience with electrical test equipment such as oscilloscopes, multimeters, power analyzers, signal generators, insulation resistance testers, and data acquisition systems.
* Experience in troubleshooting complex electrical and electronic systems.
* Familiarity with defence, aerospace, robotics, automotive, marine, or industrial embedded systems is preferred.
* Exposure to environmental qualification and EMI/EMC testing will be an advantage.
* Good documentation, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

Strong analytical and conceptual thinking to solve complex architectural conflicts.

Team-oriented mindset with the ability to mentor junior engineers.

title: Software Tester
description:
**Role Summary:**

We are seeking a highly skilled and detail-oriented ETL Senior Tester to join our growing data team. The successful candidate will be responsible for validating the accuracy, completeness, and integrity of data as it flows through our enterprise-grade Extract, Transform, Load (ETL) and Extract, Load, Transform (ELT) processes and data pipelines. This role is crucial for ensuring the reliability of our data for analytics, reporting, and critical business operations.

The ETL Tester will play a key role in designing and executing comprehensive test plans, scenarios, and cases for complex data transformations, data migrations, and data warehousing solutions. They will collaborate closely with data engineers, developers, business analysts, and other stakeholders to ensure that our data solutions meet business requirements

**Essential Responsibilities**

· Test Strategy & Planning: Analyze business, functional, and technical requirements to identify testable scenarios and clarify ambiguities in user stories and specifications. Design comprehensive test plans, test scenarios, and test cases for ETL workflows, data platforms, and reporting solutions.

· ETL Testing Execution: Execute manual and automated testing for ETL processes, data transformations, data validation, and data pipelines.

· Data Validation & Integrity: Perform thorough data validation, data comparison, and backend testing to ensure the accuracy of data transformations and mappings. Validate data mapping, transformations, aggregations, and business rules across source systems, staging layers, data warehouses, and reporting layers. Conduct data integrity checks, reconciliations, and consistency validations using advanced SQL and other data validation techniques.

· SQL Proficiency: Write and execute complex SQL queries for data validation, reconciliation, integrity checks, and to verify data transformations and business rules.

· Defect Management: Identify, log, track, and manage defects using tools such as Jira or Azure DevOps, and collaborate with developers and data engineers to resolve issues and verify fixes.

· Performance Testing: Support ETL performance testing and validate load performance against benchmarks. Analyze pipeline runtime, throughput, latency, and resource utilization.

· Documentation & Reporting: Document test execution results, defect reports, test evidence, and sign-off artifacts to support quality assurance, audits, and compliance. Communicate test results, risks, quality metrics, and recommendations clearly to cross-functional stakeholders.

· Agile Collaboration: Actively participate in Agile delivery processes, including Program Increment planning, stand-ups, sprint planning, grooming, and retrospectives, and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.

· Continuous Improvement: Incorporate learnings and best practices to improve the ETL testing process over time and contribute to continuous QA process improvements

**Required Experience**

· Bachelor’s degree or higher from a reputed university

· 6 to 10 years of experience in manual and automated testing, with a strong focus on ETL, data transformation, and data validation.

· Strong understanding of ETL processes, data warehousing concepts (facts, dimensions, star/snowflake schema), relational databases and PySpark scripting.

· Advanced SQL skills, including writing complex queries for data validation, reconciliation, and integrity checks (joins, aggregations, subqueries, window functions).

· Hands-on experience creating test cases, test scenarios, and executing test plans

· Experience with cloud platforms such as Google Cloud Platform or Azure, AWS, Dataproc or Databricks

· Experience with defect tracking tools such as Jira or Agility etc.

· Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills

· Ability to work independently and collaboratively in an Agile environment

· Experience with scripting languages like Python for test automation

**Good to have**

· Healthcare industry experience

· Familiarity with healthcare data models (claims, clinical, eligibility, provider data, etc.)

· Understanding of data governance and data quality standard

title: Quality Automation Specialist
description:
Join us as a Quality Automation Specialist
  
  

* In this key role, you’ll be undertaking and enabling automated testing activities in all delivery models
* We’ll look to you to support teams to develop quality solutions and enable continuous integration and assurance of defect free deployment of customer value
* You’ll be working closely with feature teams and a variety of stakeholders, giving you great exposure to professional development opportunities
* We're offering this role at associate level

What you'll do
  
  
Joining us in a highly collaborative role, you’ll be contributing to the transformation of testing using quality processes, tools, and methodologies, significantly improving control, accuracy and integrity. You’ll make sure repeatable, constant and consistent quality is built into all phases of the idea to value lifecycle at reduced cost or reduced time to market. It’s a chance to work with colleagues at multiple levels, and with cross-domain, domain, platform and feature teams, to build in quality as an integral part of all activities.
  
  
**Additionally, You’ll Be**

* Supporting the design of automation test strategies, aligned to business or programme goals
* Actioning and evolving more predictive and intelligent testing approaches, based on automation and innovative testing products and solutions
* Collaborating to refine the scope of manual and automated testing required, the creation of automated test scripts, user documentation and artefacts
* Designing and creating a low maintenance suite of stable, re-usable automated tests, which are usable both within the product or domain and across domains and systems in an end-to-end capacity
* Applying testing and delivery standards by understanding the product development lifecycle along with mandatory, regulatory and compliance requirements

The skills you'll need
  
  
We’re looking for someone with experience of automated testing, particularly from an Agile development or CI/CD environment. You’ll be an innovative thinker who can identify opportunities and design solutions, coupled with the ability to develop complex automation code.
  
  
You’ll have a good understanding of Agile methodologies with experience of working in an Agile team, with the ability to relate everyday work to the strategic vision of the feature.
  
  
**We’ll Also Look For You To Have**

* Experience in end-to-end and automation testing using the latest tools as recommended by the enterprise tooling framework
* A background of designing, developing and implementing automation frameworks in new environments
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to communicate complex technical concepts to management level colleagues
* Good collaboration and stakeholder management skills

title: Senior QA Engineer - Automation
description:
Team Summary
   

 Staples Print is the online print and marketing solutions division of Staples. Our print technology systems team goes beyond traditional IT. We are a team of passionate, collaborative, agile, and customer\-obsessed problem solvers who believe great print experiences start with great software. We are driven by a commitment to making it easy for businesses and individuals to bring their ideas to life from business cards and banners to custom marketing materials and beyond.
   

  

 We are intellectually curious, embrace emerging technologies, and constantly seek ways to modernize and scale our platform. We anticipate the evolving needs of our customers and business partners and deliver reliable, high\-performance technology solutions that power millions of print orders. We move fast, think big, and take pride in building experiences that are seamless, personalized, and delightful for every customer.
   

  

 Role Summary
   

 As a Senior Quality Engineer Test Automation, you will own the design, implementation, and continuous improvement of automated testing frameworks for Staples Print's eCommerce platform. You will establish testing strategies that span functional, regression, performance, and API layers and increasingly, AI\-powered feature validation ensuring high\-quality releases across web and service tiers. You will integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines, drive shift\-left quality practices, leverage AI\-assisted testing tools to improve efficiency, and mentor junior QE engineers. This is a hands\-on role that requires deep automation expertise, strong analytical skills, and a proactive, forward\-looking quality mindset.
   

  

 Duties \& Responsibilities
   

 \-Design, build, and maintain end\-to\-end automated test frameworks for web UI, API, and service\-layer testing.
   

 \-Develop and maintain automated test suites using Selenium WebDriver, Playwright, or equivalent tools for functional and regression coverage.
   

 \-Build and execute performance and load testing scenarios using StressStimulus, Apache JMeter, Gatling, or equivalent tools; analyze results and report findings to engineering teams.
   

 \-Create and maintain API test automation using RestAssured, Postman/Newman, or Karate Framework.
   

 \-Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or Jenkins) to enable continuous quality gates.
   

 \-Apply AI\-assisted tools such as GitHub Copilot or AI\-based test generators to accelerate test script creation, reduce maintenance burden, and explore how AI can improve testing efficiency.
   

 \-Contribute to testing AI\-powered application features including verifying output correctness, flagging unexpected behaviors, and working with the team on how to handle variability in AI\-generated responses.
   

 \-Stay current with AI testing tools and techniques, proactively experimenting with new approaches and sharing findings with the team to continuously improve quality practices.
   

 \-Contribute to developing acceptance criteria for AI\-generated content considering factors like relevance, tone, and accuracy in collaboration with product and engineering teams.
   

 \-Define and own test strategies, test plans, and test coverage matrices aligned to product requirements.
   

 \-Collaborate with development engineers during feature development to influence testability, design, and acceptance criteria.
   

 \-Perform exploratory, functional, regression, and smoke testing across web and API layers as needed.
   

 \-Triage, reproduce, and clearly document defects; track resolution and validate fixes.
   

 \-Analyze test results, identify failure patterns, and drive root\-cause analysis on recurring quality issues.
   

 \-Champion quality metrics test coverage, defect escape rate, automation ROI and report to engineering leadership.
   

 \-Mentor junior QE engineers on automation practices, tooling, and quality\-first mindset.
   

 \-Evaluate and recommend new testing tools, frameworks, and methodologies to continuously improve quality practices.
   

  

  

  

  

 Requirements
   

  

 Years of Experience
   

  

 Minimum of 3 years of experience in an eCommerce and automation engineering lead role.
   

 Minimum of 2 years of experience working with high\-traffic, large\-scale distributed systems and cloud platforms.
   

  

 Basic Qualifications
   

  

 \-Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
   

 \-4\+ years of experience in software quality engineering with at least 3 years focused on test automation.
   

 \-Strong hands\-on expertise with Selenium WebDriver for web UI automation (Java or C\# preferred).
   

 \-Experience with at least one modern UI automation framework: Playwright, Cypress, or TestCafe.
   

 \-Experience with performance and load testing tools: StressStimulus, Apache JMeter, Gatling, or k6\.
   

 \-Experience with API test automation: RestAssured, Postman/Newman, Karate Framework, or equivalent.
   

 \-Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or Jenkins).
   

 \-Proficiency with at least one scripting/programming language: Java, C\#, Python, or JavaScript/TypeScript.
   

 \-Strong understanding of the Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC), test design techniques, and defect management.
   

 \-Exposure to testing applications that include AI or ML\-generated outputs, with an understanding that AI responses may vary and require different validation approaches than deterministic logic.
   

 \-Awareness of AI\-assisted testing tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot for test generation, Testim, Mabl, or equivalent).
   

 \-Experience with test management tools (Azure Test Plans, Xray, TestRail, or JIRA).
   

 \-Familiarity with Page Object Model (POM) or similar design patterns for test framework architecture.
   

 \-Experience with Git and version control practices for test code.
   

 \-Excellent analytical, communication, and collaboration skills.
   

  

 Preferred Qualifications
   

  

 \-Experience with BDD frameworks: Cucumber, SpecFlow, or Behave.
   

 \-Familiarity with contract testing tools (Pact or Spring Cloud Contract).
   

 \-Experience with accessibility testing tools (Axe, WAVE, or equivalent).
   

 \-Exposure to visual regression testing (Percy, or similar).
   

 \-Experience testing microservices, event\-driven systems, or cloud\-native applications on Azure.
   

 \-Any hands\-on experience with AI\-assisted testing tools such as GitHub Copilot for writing tests, even in personal or academic projects.
   

 \-Familiarity with how Generative AI features are evaluated including awareness of concepts like output scoring or semantic comparison and an interest in applying these in a QE context.
   

 \-Experience in retail or eCommerce quality engineering contexts.
   

 \-Exposure to chaos engineering or resiliency testing methodologies.
   

 \-Familiarity with observability tools (Application Insights, Splunk) for test failure diagnostics.

description:
**Job Description** 




 To manage and control Supplier Quality, Incoming Quality, In\-Process Quality, and Outgoing Quality activities, ensuring that materials, components, manufacturing processes, assemblies, and finished products meet defined quality standards, engineering specifications, and customer requirements. The role will focus on supplier quality improvement, inspection, non\-conformance management, corrective actions, quality documentation, and continuous improvement across project and manufacturing activities.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




  





**Supplier \& Incoming Quality** 



* Manage the Non\-Conforming Material (NCM) process for incoming materials, including review, disposition, follow\-up, and closure.
* Identify and resolve supplier quality issues through effective containment and corrective actions.
* Raise and manage Supplier Corrective Action Reports (SCAR) and ensure timely closure.
* Monitor supplier performance through DPPM/PPM, rejection, defect, and trend analysis.
* Conduct supplier quality audits and follow up on audit findings.
* Support qualification of new suppliers, new parts, drawing revisions, new tooling, and new projects.
* Review supplier quality documents including Control Plans, Inspection Standards, Part Approval Records, and quality reports.
* Develop incoming inspection and test plans based on drawings, specifications, and quality requirements.
* Work proactively with suppliers to identify quality risks and improvement opportunities.



  





**In\-Process Quality** 



* Monitor production processes to ensure compliance with approved drawings, specifications, work instructions, and quality standards.
* Conduct first\-off, in\-process, and process inspections.
* Develop and maintain process inspection criteria and Control Plans.
* Identify process\-related quality issues and drive effective corrective and preventive actions.
* Coordinate with Production and Engineering teams to reduce defects, rework, and scrap.
* Conduct process audits and ensure corrective actions are implemented effectively.
* Support prototype, trial, pre\-production, and new product/project activities.



  





**Outgoing Quality** 



* Manage final inspection and outgoing quality activities before product dispatch.
* Develop and implement final inspection and testing plans.
* Verify product dimensions, appearance, functionality, assembly quality, and customer\-specific requirements.
* Ensure finished products are released only after meeting defined quality standards.
* Review and maintain final inspection reports and quality records.
* Support customer inspections, FAT, pre\-dispatch inspections, and other customer quality requirements.
* Identify outgoing quality issues and implement corrective and preventive actions.



  





**Quality Equipment \& Inspection** 



* Perform and supervise inspection using quality measurement equipment.
* Ensure proper use and handling of inspection and measuring equipment.
* Maintain awareness of calibration requirements.
* Familiarity with all the quality equipment’s.
* Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, tolerances, and GD\&T requirements.



  





**Quality Systems \& Documentation** 



* Maintain quality records, inspection reports, NCR/NCM records, supplier quality documents, and corrective\-action reports.
* Ensure compliance with company Quality Management System (QMS) requirements.
* Support ISO 9001 internal audits, CSER audits, customer audits, and supplier audits.
* Monitor and report key quality metrics to management.
* Maintain supplier quality reports and supplier scorecards.
* Ensure timely closure of NCRs, SCARs, CAPAs, and audit findings.



**Continuous Improvement** 




 Drive quality improvement initiatives to reduce defects, rejection, rework, scrap, and customer complaints.
 



 Use quality tools such as:
 


* 8D
* 5 Why
* Fishbone Analysis
* Pareto Analysis
* Root Cause Analysis
* CAPA
* SPC
* MSA
* FMEA



 Analyze quality trends and identify recurring problems.
 



 Drive measurable improvement projects with suppliers and internal teams.
 



  





**Team Management** 



* Supervise and guide QA Inspectors for incoming, in\-process, and outgoing inspection activities.
* Allocate inspection activities and ensure timely completion.
* Train and develop QA inspectors on inspection methods, drawings, quality standards, and measuring equipment.
* Ensure consistent application of inspection standards and procedures.
* Monitor team productivity and inspection effectiveness.



  





**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)** 



* Supplier DPPM/PPM performance
* Incoming rejection rate
* In\-process defect rate
* Outgoing/customer rejection rate
* NCM/NCR ageing and closure
* SCAR/CAPA closure time
* Customer complaints
* Supplier audit performance
* First Pass Yield (FPY)
* Reduction in rework and scrap
* On\-time inspection and product release
* Supplier and internal quality improvement.



  





**Required Skills** 




  




* Supplier Quality Management
* Incoming, In\-Process \& Outgoing Quality
* Non\-Conformance / NCR / NCM Management
* SCAR / CAPA / 8D
* Root Cause Analysis
* Engineering Drawing \& GD\&T
* Quality Inspection \& Measurement Equipment
* Quality Management Systems (QMS)
* ISO 9001
* DPPM/PPM \& Quality Trend Analysis
* Supplier Audits
* Microsoft Excel / Microsoft 365
* SAP / ERP Systems
* Good communication and supplier\-management skills
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Attention to detail.



  





**Qualifications** 




  




* Bachelor's Degree or Diploma in Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics, Mechatronics, Manufacturing, or related Engineering discipline.
* 3–5 years of relevant experience in Supplier Quality, Incoming Quality, Process Quality, or Outgoing Quality.
* Hands\-on experience in supplier quality, inspection, manufacturing quality, and corrective\-action management.



  





**Preferred Experience** 




  




* Experience in manufacturing, project\-based, engineering, or assembly environments.
* Experience with profiles, harnesses, SST/stainless\-steel components, fabrication, and mechanical/electrical assemblies.
* Experience with CMM and vision measurement systems.
* Knowledge of PPAP, APQP, FMEA, Control Plans, SPC, and MSA.
* Knowledge of Minitab or other statistical analysis software.
* Experience in supplier audits and supplier development.
* Willingness to travel to supplier locations when required.

description:
**Company Overview**
 KLA is a global leader in diversified electronics for the semiconductor manufacturing ecosystem. Virtually every electronic device in the world is produced using our technologies. No laptop, smartphone, wearable device, voice\-controlled gadget, flexible screen, VR device or smart car would have made it into your hands without us. KLA invents systems and solutions for the manufacturing of wafers and reticles, integrated circuits, packaging, printed circuit boards and flat panel displays. The innovative ideas and devices that are advancing humanity all begin with inspiration, research and development. KLA focuses more than average on innovation and we invest 15% of sales back into R\&D. Our expert teams of physicists, engineers, data scientists and problem\-solvers work together with the world’s leading technology providers to accelerate the delivery of tomorrow’s electronic devices. Life here is exciting and our teams thrive on tackling really hard problems. There is never a dull moment with us.
   

  

**Group/Division**
 With over 40 years of semiconductor process control experience, chipmakers around the globe rely on KLA to ensure that their fabs ramp next\-generation devices to volume production quickly and cost\-effectively. Enabling the movement towards advanced chip design, KLA's Global Products Group (GPG), which is responsible for creating all of KLA’s metrology and inspection products, is looking for the best and the brightest research scientist, software engineers, application development engineers, and senior product technology process engineers.  The WLAN Performance Test Engineer is responsible for validating the throughput, latency, RF performance of Wi\-Fi products and Power efficiency under various real\-world and lab conditions. The role ensures compliance with IEEE 802\.11 standards and identifies performance bottlenecks at PHY/MAC layers.

* Simulate customer field environment and test performance with different devices including iOS, Mac, Android, Windows
* Execute testing inside shield boxes or anechoic chambers.
* Load \& Scalability Testing
* Validate performance under high client density scenarios.
* Simulate concurrent traffic (VoIP, video streaming, web traffic).
* Interference Testing
* Test performance under co\-channel and adjacent channel interference.
* Evaluate performance in 2\.4GHz, 5GHz, and 6GHz bands.
* Automation \& Scripting
* Develop automation scripts using C Sharp, Python.
* Automate log collection, KPI extraction and triaging.
* Debug \& Root Cause Analysis
* Analyze packet captures (Wireshark).
* Interpret logs from AP, STA, and driver layers.
* Work with firmware and PHY teams for issue resolution.
* Establish performance benchmarks and release qualification criteria
* Mentor engineers, review test strategy/design and promote testing best practices
* Support customer escalations with in\-depth performance analysis.

* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree
* 10\-15\+ years of experience in WLAN System or performance validation

* Tools: Experience with IXIA / Spirent / Keysight test equipment, iPerf, Wireshark
* Networking: Knowledge of TCP/IP stack and preferred experience in Layer 2/Layer 3 networking.
* Analytical tools: Expertise in log analysis tools (Wireshark, tcpdump) for troubleshooting connectivity and performance issues
