title: Sr. Test Analyst
description:
**Job Summary**
 Serve as a senior test analyst specializing in MES validation and automation for hybrid work model projects ensuring high quality manufacturing execution solutions through rigorous functional integration and AI assisted testing. Apply expertise in Camstar MES platforms and multi layer integration to improve reliability reduce defects and support efficient supply chain operations while collaborating with diverse global teams.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Design and execute comprehensive test strategies for MES validation that align with project scope regulatory expectations and enterprise quality standards ensuring reliable delivery of manufacturing execution capabilities across hybrid work environments.
* Develop and maintain detailed automated test suites for MES applications using suitable frameworks focusing on regression coverage repeatability and rapid feedback to project teams to reduce release cycle times and production defects.
* Perform thorough manual functional and integration testing for MES features where automation is not yet feasible documenting clear test conditions reproducible steps and evidence to support release readiness decisions.
* Validate and test MES L4 L3 and L2 integration flows across enterprise planning systems shop floor control systems and field devices ensuring accurate data exchange timing and transaction integrity for manufacturing and supply chain scenarios.
* Configure and validate Camstar MES features workflows and business rules in test environments ensuring that process configurations meet user requirements while upholding data integrity and traceability standards for regulated manufacturing contexts.
* Utilize generative AI tools in a compliant manner to accelerate test design test data generation and defect analysis while applying critical judgment to review AI generated outputs for accuracy relevance and risk.
* Collaborate closely with business analysts developers MES engineers and operations stakeholders to clarify requirements define acceptance criteria and proactively identify risks or gaps that could impact manufacturing continuity or supply chain visibility.
* Analyze test results and production like data patterns to identify systemic defects performance bottlenecks and integration issues then work with technical teams to prioritize and verify fixes that provide measurable operational improvements.
* Create and maintain clear test documentation including test plans test cases traceability matrices and execution reports that support audits and provide transparent evidence of validation coverage for all MES components.
* Provide mentoring and practical guidance to other test professionals on MES validation techniques automated testing practices and integration testing patterns fostering a culture of quality ownership across the delivery team.
* Engage in defect triage sessions and change review activities presenting well reasoned impact analyses and retest strategies that balance quality risk with project timelines for day shift hybrid operations.
* Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives by identifying opportunities to enhance test automation frameworks test data management and environment stability thereby increasing efficiency across recurring MES validation cycles.
* Partner with manufacturing and supply chain stakeholders to understand process flows and key performance indicators ensuring that test scenarios reflect real operational conditions and help safeguard product quality and service reliability.


**Qualifications**
* Demonstrate extensive hands on experience in MES validation and automated testing with a proven track record of owning test design execution and reporting for complex enterprise scale implementations.
* Exhibit strong proficiency in manual MES validation activities including requirement analysis test case creation risk based prioritization and evidence collection suitable for regulated manufacturing environments.
* Show advanced skills in testing L4 L3 and L2 integration scenarios across planning manufacturing and shop floor systems with an ability to troubleshoot data flow discrepancies and interface failures effectively.
* Apply practical knowledge of generative AI in the context of software quality engineering using it to enhance test asset creation and analysis while maintaining strict review controls and compliance awareness.
* Demonstrate deep working knowledge of Camstar MES configuration object modeling and workflow behavior enabling precise validation of manufacturing processes and electronic records under varied operational conditions.
* Display solid understanding of manufacturing and supply chain business processes including work order management inventory tracking and quality events so that test coverage aligns with real world operational needs.
* Communicate findings and recommendations clearly in written and spoken form to cross functional teams enabling timely decisions on release readiness and risk mitigation in a hybrid day shift setting.
* Maintain strong analytical and problem solving capabilities supported by a methodical approach to root cause analysis that helps reduce recurring defects and enhances overall MES ecosystem stability.

Our elite team of subject matter experts works closely with clients to assess, optimize, and transform their content objectives and operations. Our global team allows us to support clients in 40 countries, including many of the world's largest companies and iconic brands, from various industries such as Government, Aerospace, Publishing, Consumer Products, Healthcare, Industrial, Technology, and Financial Services.
   

  

**Position Summary**
 Contiem is seeking a highly skilled and experienced Lead/Senior SQA Analyst to join our team and support testing for our Web, Desktop, and mobile applications. As a Senior SQA Analyst, you will play a critical role in ensuring the quality, reliability, and usability of our documentation tools. Your primary responsibility will be to design, execute, and maintain testing strategies and test cases to validate the functionality and performance of our software applications.
   

  

**Essential Duties \& Responsibilities**
**Quality Ownership \& Technical Leadership**
* Own end\-to\-end quality of releases through comprehensive test planning, execution, and risk assessment.
* Define and drive test strategies, quality standards, risk\-based testing approaches, and release readiness criteria across multiple product areas.
* Act as a technical escalation point; mentor colleagues on test case design, automation frameworks, and QA best practices.
* Collaborate with Product Management, Engineering, and Professional Services teams to influence product quality decisions.
* Conduct root cause analysis, track defect metrics, and drive continuous process improvements.
* Participate in release retrospectives, providing actionable testing insights to improve product quality.
* Champion quality advocacy across teams, ensuring adherence to standards and compliance requirements.


**Test Strategy \& Coverage**
* Analyze requirements and user stories to identify gaps, ambiguities, and risks; design targeted test plans accordingly.
* Execute manual and automated tests across web, Windows desktop, mobile (iOS/Android), APIs, databases, and XML content.
* Validate XML against schemas/DTDs (e.g., S1000D, DITA, custom) to ensure product compliance.
* Perform accessibility testing (WCAG \& EAA), performance testing (JMeter), functional, regression, and exploratory testing.
* Ensure test coverage across integration, system, and user acceptance testing phases.


**Automation \& CI/CD Excellence**
* Architect and optimize scalable automation frameworks like Playwright and Selenium.
* Implement Power Automate flows to streamline testing workflows.
* Integrate and maintain automation within Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines for continuous quality validation.
* Maintain test data management strategies to support automation and regression testing.
* Assist in expanding automated coverage across UI, API, workflow, and data validation layers.
* Develop automation approaches for XML validation, publishing verification, and content quality checks.
* Analyze automation effectiveness and continuously improve test coverage.


**Functional \& Workflow Testing**
* Design and execute comprehensive test plans, test cases, and test strategies for enterprise content management solutions.
* Validate complex XML based structured authoring, review, approval, and publishing workflows.
* Test automated workflows, including content creation, reuse, versioning, branching, localization, metadata management, and publication processes.
* Validate workflow orchestration across multiple integrated systems and services.
* Ensure content integrity throughout the content lifecycle.

* Experience with Python for automation, test engineering, scripting, and data processing.

* Understanding of Agile, DevOps, CI/CD, and Continuous Testing practices.

* Strong collaboration skills and ability to work effectively within and across teams.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to review deliverables and ensure quality, accuracy, and adherence to standards.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Experience with Java development, including APIs, multithreading, Spring Boot, and enterprise application frameworks.

* Experience with Python development for automation and tooling.

 The Industrialization Team in GE Vernova\- SMP (Chennai) is seeking a skilled Mechatronics Engineer to lead the design and development of automated test systems and fixtures for production facilities. This role focuses on the mechanical, automation, robotics, and mechatronics aspects of custom production and test solutions, supporting global standardization and continuous improvement of existing equipment. You will collaborate closely with R\&D and process engineering teams to ensure NPI (New Product Introduction) success, high\-quality production output, and operational excellence.
   

  

**Job Description**
 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* System Design \& Development: Design and develop integrated mechanical and mechatronic solutions for custom automated test systems.
* Standards \& Compliance: Ensure all equipment designs strictly adhere to BIS standards, including IEC 61010, IS 14476 (ISO 12100\), IS 14811, and IS 15051\. Maintain compliance with IS/ISO 10218 regarding robotics and automation safety.
* Process Optimization: Apply automation and robotics to enhance manufacturing safety, quality, repeatability, and throughput.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Partner with test engineers to integrate mechanical components with switching hardware, sensors, actuators, and communication interfaces.
* NPI Integration: Participate in NPI gateway reviews to support the design and implementation of test stations, ensuring production\-ready solutions on schedule.
* Continuous Improvement: Proactively upgrade existing test stations and fixtures to improve performance, reliability, and maintainability.
* Hands\-on Execution: Provide direct support for the assembly, debugging, implementation, and troubleshooting of new or modified automation systems.
* Operational Excellence: Actively contribute to organizational safety protocols, Kaizen initiatives, cost\-out projects, and global standardization efforts across the industrialization lifecycle.


**Qualifications**
* Education: Degree in Mechatronics or related field.
* Experience: 5\+ years of professional experience in electrical and mechanical design.
* Technical Skills:
+ Proficiency in 2D/3D CAD software (AutoCAD, SolidWorks).
+ Strong programming capabilities (LabVIEW, Python).
+ Demonstrated expertise in automation equipment, fixtures, robotics, and manufacturing systems.

* Desire candidates:


 Proven ability to collaborate effectively with cross\-functional teams, including electrical and software engineers.
   

  

 Experience in high\-precision manufacturing or industrial test environments.
   

  

 Personal Characteristics
   

  

* Ability to work independently as well as in a team environment
* Willingness to share ideas and collaborate openly with others
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Proactive approach to work and ability to take initiative
* Strong communication skills, including a constructive and open approach to conflict resolution
* Flexible and adaptable, with openness to changing priorities and tasks
* Self\-motivated and able to manage work effectively with minimal supervision
* Strong organizational skills


******Additional Information******
**Relocation Assistance Provided:** 
 No

title: SAP VIM Consultant
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**SAP VIM Consultant Functional Transformation**
**Enterprise Performance**
 Our Enterprise Performance team helps clients unlock value from enterprise platforms and digital technologies across finance, supply chain, manufacturing, and IT operations. As an SAP VIM Functional Consultant, you will support clients in improving invoice management, document processing, and accounts payable operations through technology\-enabled transformation.

You will bring functional knowledge, configuration experience, and a delivery\-focused approach to help clients improve operational efficiency and achieve sustainable business outcomes.
   

  

**Level** 
 : Consultant or equivalent

Need\-basis you will be mentoring and/or directing junior team members/liaising with onsite/offshore teams to understand the functional requirements.

* Support implementation, enhancement, and production support activities for SAP OpenText Vendor Invoice Management and Business Capture Center solutions.
* Configure and troubleshoot invoice processing capabilities, including ArchiveLink, document pipeline, document types, approval workflows, roles, and central reporting.
* Translate business requirements into functional designs and support testing, defect analysis, and deployment activities across business applications and environments.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders and cross\-functional teams to resolve data, process, and application issues and support timely project delivery.

title: Associate - Reporting Production Expert
description:
**Description**
**Job Title:** 
 Associate
   

  

**Department:** 
 Asset Management – Investment Operations
   

  

**About Business line/Function:** 
 Reporting Production Analyst
   

  

**Position Purpose**
 The Reporting Production Analyst is responsible for the day\-to\-day execution of regulatory transaction reporting obligations across EMIR Refit, SFTR, MiFID II covering both EU and UK jurisdictions, and ASIC Rewrite. The role sits at the heart of the first line of defense for regulatory reporting, ensuring that all reportable transactions are submitted accurately, completely and on time to the relevant Trade Repositories and Approved Reporting Mechanisms across jurisdictions.
   

  

 Reporting to the Regulatory Transaction Reporting team, the Production Analyst works as part of a team with interchangeable resources, each expected to operate across all four regulatory regimes and across both EU and UK jurisdictions where applicable. This versatility is essential to ensure business continuity, balance workload across the team, and provide a single, consistent operating standard regardless of the reporting regime. For SFTR and MiFID II, the Analyst is responsible for the hands\-on day\-to\-day production of regulatory reporting. For EMIR and ASIC, which are delegated, the Analyst is responsible for the oversight and monitoring of the production performed by the service provider, ensuring reporting obligations are met.
   

  

 The role combines hands\-on production (SFTR, MiFID II), oversight of outsourced reporting performed (EMIR OTC, ASIC), oversight of delegated EMIR reporting on ETD performed by clearing brokers, exception remediation, accuracy controls, reconciliations, pairing \& matching, and reporting to senior stakeholders. It requires strong attention to detail, an in\-depth understanding of regulatory reporting mechanics across EU and UK regimes, and the ability to challenge and monitor an outsourced provider as effectively as performing the reporting directly.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* OVERSIGHT \& MONITORING OF OUTSOURCED REPORTING EMIR EU, EMIR UK, ASIC


 Perform daily oversight of the EMIR EU and UK scopes, and ASIC reporting production carried out by 3rd party Service Provider (SP), ensuring completeness, accuracy and timeliness of all reporting to DTCC.
   

  

 Monitor 3rd party SP daily production, submission status and exception handling, and challenge the provider where standards are not met.
   

  

 Review and validate the controls performed 3rd party SP, ensuring they are operating effectively and evidenced.
   

  

 Reconcile the internal trade population against the reports submitted by 3rd party SP to identify missing, duplicated or incorrectly reported transactions.
   

  

 Track and escalate persistent issues, recurring exceptions or SLA breaches by 3rd party SP to RTR team.
   

  

 Maintain documented evidence of the oversight performed, supporting second\-line oversight and internal/external audit requirements.
   

  

 Act as the point of contact for 3rd party SP on EMIR EU and UK scopes, and ASIC production matters.
   

  

* DAILY TRADE AND TRANSACTION REPORTING ACROSS SFTR (EU AND UK), MIFID II (EU AND UK)


 Execute daily production reporting, ensuring all reportable trades and transactions are submitted within the regulatory deadlines.
   

  

 Monitor reporting platforms and intraday flows to ensure timely capture and submission of all reportable events.
   

  

 Validate report content against source systems post submission.
   

  

 Track submission status and ensure all reports reach a final accepted state by Trade Repository or ARM/APA.
   

  

* REJECTIONS AND EXCEPTIONS REMEDIATION


 Investigate and remediate all rejections (NACKs) and exceptions raised by the reporting platforms and/or Trade Repository across EU and UK regimes.
   

  

 Identify root causes (data quality, mapping, reference data, timing) and apply the appropriate corrective actions.
   

  

 Make the necessary amendments and resubmit corrected reports within the regulatory timeframe applicable in each jurisdiction.
   

  

 Maintain a clear audit trail of remediation activities for compliance and oversight review.
   

  

* DAILY AND MONTHLY RECONCILIATION


 Perform daily reconciliation on SFTR, MIFID, across EU and UK scopes to identify missing, incorrect or duplicated reports, investigate breaks, and implement remediation actions to resolve reconciliation breaks.
   

  

 For EMIR EU and UK scopes, and ASIC, reconcile the internal data against 3rd party SP reported output as part of the oversight function.
   

  

 Execute monthly reconciliations to validate the consistency between source data, and data submitted.
   

  

 Document reconciliation results and escalate unresolved breaks to the Regulatory Transactions Reporting team with proposed resolution actions and timeline.
   

  

* OVERSIGHT OF DELEGATED EMIR REPORTING ON ETD SCOPE PERFORMED BY CLEARING BROKERS


 Validate completeness, accuracy and timeliness of reports submitted by clearing brokers.
   

  

 Engage directly with clearing brokers to investigate discrepancies, request amendments and ensure corrections are made within the regulatory timeframe.
   

  

 Track and escalate persistent issues or recurring reporting failures to RTR team.
   

  

 Maintain documented evidence of the oversight performed, supporting RTR oversight and internal/external audit requirements.
   

  

* PAIRING AND MATCHING


 Investigate and resolve unpaired or unmatched transactions across EU and UK regimes, engaging directly with counterparties where required.
   

  

 Manage UTIs processing in line with internal procedures.
   

  

 Monitor and secure pairing and matching rates as a key indicator of reporting quality.
   

  

* REPORTING TO RTR TEAM


 Prepare and share daily statistics and dashboards for all jurisdictions (EU and UK for EMIR/MIFID/SFTR and ASIC) covering reported volumes, pairing and matching rates, accepted volumes, rejection rates and remediated volumes.
   

  

 Highlight emerging/faced issues, trends or risks to the RTR team in a timely and structured manner.
   

  

* CONTINUOUS IMPROVEMENT AND KNOWLEDGE SHARING


 Identify ad escalate recurring issues.
   

  

 Maintain up\-to\-date procedures, runbooks and knowledge base for all four regulatory regimes.
   

  

 Cross\-train and support fellow team members to maintain full interchangeability across the team.
   

  

 Stay updated with regulatory requirements changes and contribute to impact assessments when changes are announced.
   

  

**Specific Qualifications**
* MANDATORY:


 Minimum 2–3 years’ experience in regulatory transaction reporting within the financial services industry (asset management, sell\-side).
   

  

 Solid understanding of regulatory reporting mechanics: report submission lifecycles, ACK/NACK handling, UTI mechanics, pairing and matching, lifecycle events and action types.
   

  

 Strong working knowledge of at least one of EMIR Refit, SFTR, MiFID II or ASIC Rewrite and the ability/willingness to acquire expertise across all four.
   

  

 Demonstrated ability to monitor and challenge an outsourced reporting provider, including reviewing their controls, reconciliations and SLA performance.
   

  

 Strong Excel skills (pivot tables, lookups, conditional logic) for reconciliation and reporting purposes.
   

  

* NICE TO HAVE:


 Working knowledge of 2 regulatory regimes or more (EMIR Refit, SFTR, MiFID II, ASIC Rewrite).
   

  

 Hands\-on experience with platforms such as: Aladdin, TRAX (ARM/APA), Tri\-Optima, DTCC, IHS Markit.
   

  

**Required Skills**
 Versatility and ability to switch between regimes and reporting flows depending on workload.
   

  

 Strong analytical and investigative skills, with ability to perform root\-cause analysis on data quality issues.
   

  

 Capability to translate reporting issues into clear messages for the RTR team and management.
   

  

 Capability to produce presentations and KPIs representative of reporting quality and activities in scope.
   

  

 Ability to support colleagues to achieve interchangeability, through documentation, knowledge sharing and active collaboration.
   

  

**Behavioral Skills**
* Active Listening
* Adaptability
* Ability to share/pass on knowledge
* Attention to detail


**Education Level:** 
 Bachelor’s degree or Equivalent
   

  

**Location:** 
 Chennai
   

  

**About BNP Paribas Group**
 BNP Paribas is the European Union’s leading bank and key player in international banking. It operates in 65 countries and has nearly 185,000 employees, including more than 145,000 in Europe. The Group has key positions in its three main fields of activity: Commercial, Personal Banking \& Services for the Group’s commercial \& personal banking and several specialized businesses including BNP Paribas Personal Finance and Arval; Investment \& Protection Services for savings, investment, and protection solutions; and Corporate \& Institutional Banking, focused on corporate and institutional clients. Based on its strong diversified and integrated model, the Group helps all its clients (individuals, community associations, entrepreneurs, SMEs, corporates and institutional clients) to realize their projects through solutions spanning financing, investment, savings and protection insurance. In Europe, BNP Paribas has four domestic markets: Belgium, France, Italy, and Luxembourg. The Group is rolling out its integrated commercial \& personal banking model across several Mediterranean countries, Turkey, and Eastern Europe. As a key player in international banking, the Group has leading platforms and business lines in Europe, a strong presence in the Americas as well as a solid and fast\-growing business in Asia\-Pacific. BNP Paribas has implemented a Corporate Social Responsibility approach in all its
   

  

 activities, enabling it to contribute to the construction of a sustainable future, while ensuring the Group's performance and stability.
   

  

**About BNP Paribas India Solutions**
 Established in 2005, BNP Paribas India Solutions is a wholly owned subsidiary of BNP Paribas SA, European Union’s leading bank with an international reach. With delivery centers located in Bengaluru, Chennai and Mumbai, we are a 24x7 global delivery center. India Solutions services three business lines: Corporate and Institutional Banking, Investment Solutions and Retail Banking for BNP Paribas across the Group. Driving innovation and growth, we are harnessing the potential of over 10000 employees, to provide support and develop best\-in\-class solutions.
   

  

**Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion**
 At BNP Paribas, we passionately embrace diversity and are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where all employees are valued, respected and can bring their authentic selves to work. We prohibit Discrimination and Harassment of any kind and our policies promote equal employment opportunity for all employees and applicants, irrespective of, but not limited to their gender, gender identity, sex, sexual orientation, ethnicity, race, colour, national origin, age, religion, social status, mental or physical disabilities, veteran status etc. As a global Bank, we truly believe that inclusion and diversity of our teams is key to our success in serving our clients and the communities we operate in. As a global Bank, we truly believe that inclusion and diversity of our teams is key to our success in serving our clients and the communities we operate in.

**EY \- GDS Consulting** 
 –

 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.

The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.

title: Engineer 2, Development Engineer
description:
Comcast brings together the best in media and technology. We drive innovation to create the world's best entertainment and online experiences. As a Fortune 50 leader, we set the pace in a variety of innovative and fascinating businesses and create career opportunities across a wide range of locations and disciplines. We are at the forefront of change and move at an amazing pace, thanks to our remarkable people, who bring cutting\-edge products and services to life for millions of customers every day. If you share in our passion for teamwork, our vision to revolutionize industries and our goal to lead the future in media and technology, we want you to fast\-forward your career at Comcast.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 We are seeking a highly motivated Software Developer with strong expertise in Python development, API integration, containerized application development, and modern cloud\-native technologies. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, troubleshooting, and maintaining scalable applications and services while ensuring reliability, observability, and operational excellence. This role requires hands\-on experience with API\-based integrations, debugging distributed systems, Docker containerization, Kubernetes deployments, and emerging AI/LLM technologies.
   

  

**Job Description**
 Software Development
   

  

* Design, develop, test, and maintain scalable applications and backend services using Python.
* Develop clean, reusable, and maintainable code following software engineering best practices.
* Participate in code reviews and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.
* Collaborate with product owners, architects, and cross\-functional teams to deliver high\-quality solutions.


 API Development \& Integration
   

  

* Develop and integrate RESTful APIs and third\-party services.
* Build reliable data connections between enterprise applications and external platforms.
* Troubleshoot API failures, latency issues, and service reliability concerns.
* Design resilient integration patterns with proper error handling and retry mechanisms.


 Application Support \& Troubleshooting
   

  

* Debug and resolve issues across distributed applications and microservices.
* Analyze logs, metrics, and traces to identify root causes and optimize system performance.
* Participate in incident management, problem resolution, and post\-incident reviews.
* Support production environments and ensure application uptime and reliability.


 Observability \& Monitoring

* Monitor application health using logs, metrics, and basic distributed tracing.
* Create dashboards and alerts to proactively identify operational issues.
* Support performance analysis and capacity planning activities.


 Containerization \& Kubernetes

* Create and maintain container images following security and optimization best practices.
* Deploy and manage applications within Kubernetes environments.
* Troubleshoot Pods, Deployment failures, and application logs.

 Configuration \& Security
   

  

* Environment variable management
* Secrets management
* Azure Key Vault or equivalent secret management solutions
* Secure application configuration practices


 Software Engineering Practices
   

  

* Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC)
* Agile/Scrum methodologies
* Documentation and technical design reviews
* Test\-driven and quality\-focused development


 Comcast is an equal opportunity workplace.  Base pay is one part of the Total Rewards that Comcast provides to compensate and recognize employees for their work. title: Billing Rules Associate
description:
Join us as we work to create a thriving ecosystem that delivers accessible, high\-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all.
   

  

**Billing Rules Associate**
**Role Summary**
 Billing Rules Associate is a hybrid role based in Chennai, India that supports the testing and validation of billing rules across practice\-specific, federal health, and payer\-specific workflows. This position helps confirm that billing rules are tested against approved requirements and that results are documented accurately for sign\-off. The role works closely with cross\-functional partners to review requirements, validate outcomes, and support readiness for production. This position will report to the Manager.
   

  

**Team Summary**
 This team is responsible for testing billing rules in a pre\-production environment using internal tools and verifying that the rule designer output aligns with business requirements and expected testing outcomes. The work involves coordinating with internal stakeholders across India and the U.S. to clarify requirements, review test results, and support sign\-off on rule changes. The team supports a broad range of rule types, including practice\-specific rules, federal health rules, payer\-specific rules, and Federally Qualified Health Center (FQHC) workflows. Success in this role depends on clear communication, careful validation, and consistent follow\-through across teams.
   

  

**Essential Job Responsibilities**
* Review billing rule requirements and confirm they are reflected accurately in test scenarios and expected outcomes.
* Execute billing rules testing in a pre\-production environment using internal tools and document results against approved business requirements.
* Validate rule designer configurations to ensure alignment with billing rules, practice\-specific rules, federal health rules, payer\-specific rules, and FQHC workflows.
* Coordinate with stakeholders across India and the U.S. to clarify requirements, review test results, and support issue resolution.
* Identify gaps between business requirements and testing outcomes and communicate findings clearly for resolution.
* Track defects, retest fixes, and confirm that updates meet expected billing rule behavior.
* Prepare test evidence, status updates, and sign\-off documentation for assigned billing rule work.
* Support billing process validation by applying knowledge of billing rules and healthcare workflows.
* Apply AI\-enabled tools or features, when available, to help organize test evidence, summarize findings, or improve task efficiency while using human review to confirm accuracy and final decisions.


**Additional Job Responsibilities**
* Assist in reviewing process updates and contributing to improvements in testing methods.
* Participate in team discussions to share observations and support knowledge transfer.
* Help maintain documentation related to billing rules testing and validation.
* Escalate issues that may affect timelines, quality, or accuracy of testing deliverables.
* Contribute to audit readiness by keeping test records complete and organized.
* Support ad hoc analysis related to billing rule behaviour or testing questions.
* Collaborate on standardization efforts that improve consistency in rule validation.
* Perform other related duties as assigned.


**Expected Education \& Experience**
* Bachelor’s degree in a related field or equivalent practical experience.
* 0 to 5 years of experience in healthcare operations, billing, testing, or a related business systems role.
* Experience or familiarity with billing rules review, validation, or testing.
* Experience or familiarity with practice\-specific rules, federal health rules, payer\-specific rules, and Federally Qualified Health Centre (FQHC) billing workflows.
* Ability to review requirements, compare expected versus actual outcomes, and document results clearly.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills for working with internal stakeholders across multiple locations.
* Ability to manage multiple assignments, follow testing steps, and meet deadlines in a hybrid work environment.
* Experience using testing, workflow, or documentation tools is preferred.

**The Impact You Will Have In This Role**
 The Test Engineering role is responsible for ensuring that all applications, system products, projects, and solutions meet defined enterprise quality standards. Provide centralized, independent quality assurance services across the firm, including functional and non\-functional testing for all products, services, and applications across businesses. Design, develop, and maintain automated testing solutions, providing testing expertise, oversight, and direction to ensure the functionality of solutions and that design specifications are met.
   

  

**Your Primary Responsibilities**
* Safeguard a global post\-trade platform — Your test automation will directly protect the reliability of a system used daily by investment managers, broker/dealers, and custodian banks worldwide, where a single defect can carry real financial and regulatory consequences.
* Raise the quality bar across the SDLC — You will embed quality earlier and deeper into delivery, shifting testing left and enabling faster, more confident releases without compromising stability.
* Accelerate delivery through AI\-augmented testing — By leveraging AI for test generation, self\-healing UI locators, and reusable automation assets, you'll reduce manual test effort, shorten regression cycles, and free the team to focus on higher\-value work.
* De\-risk a major platform modernization — Your validation of Oracle\-to\-PostgreSQL database migrations will ensure data integrity and functional parity as the platform modernizes, protecting the business from migration\-related regressions.
* Elevate the engineering team — Through technical leadership and mentorship, you'll uplift the QA engineering team's skills, establish automation best practices, and create a durable culture of quality ownership.
* Enable full\-stack confidence — By driving coverage across UI, API, database, and integration layers of a multi\-service containerized architecture, you'll give stakeholders end\-to\-end assurance that the platform behaves correctly at every tier.


**Qualifications**

* Deep expertise in keyword\-driven / data\-driven automation frameworks, including designing, extending, and maintaining reusable framework components.
* Strong programming skills in a language such as Python, Java, or C\# for building robust, maintainable automation.
* Proven experience automating across multiple layers — UI, REST/SOAP API, database, and end\-to\-end integration testing.
* Solid database and SQL proficiency, with practical experience validating data across relational systems (Oracle, PostgreSQL) and testing data migrations.
* Working knowledge of containerized, microservices architectures (e.g., Docker/Kubernetes) and testing in distributed, multi\-service environments.
* Experience integrating automation into CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Jenkins, Azure DevOps, GitLab) for continuous testing.
* Exposure to AI\-assisted testing tools for test generation, self\-healing locators, or intelligent test maintenance is a strong plus.
* Prior experience leading or mentoring QA engineers and setting technical direction for a testing practice.

**Job Summary**
 Consulting Analyst role in a hybrid work model focusing on complex router technologies ( Meta Router (Preferred)
   

  

 ) and modern application routing solutions for multinational clients in the telecom and digital services sectors. The role involves analyzing client needs designing scalable routing architectures and guiding implementation that optimizes reliability revenue flows and customer experience while aligning with business strategy and regulatory expectations.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Drive detailed consulting assessments that analyze client routing ecosystems across ICM Router Servers React Router and Cloud Router to identify performance gaps reliability risks and optimization opportunities that directly improve service continuity and customer satisfaction.
* Design robust routing solutions that integrate ICM Router Servers with Cloud Router platforms and application level routing using React Router to create scalable architectures that support high transaction volumes and evolving digital service demands.
* Provide expert guidance on configuring and tuning router services to improve latency throughput and fault tolerance while keeping operational overhead manageable and aligning configurations with enterprise standards and audit expectations.
* Collaborate closely with cross functional client teams in architecture operations and product to translate complex routing requirements into practical implementation roadmaps and clear milestones that reduce delivery risk and accelerate value realization.
* Develop comprehensive solution documentation that explains routing flows error handling paths and integration touchpoints in language understandable for technical and business stakeholders to support smoother adoption and ongoing maintenance.
* Analyze incident trends and routing related defects to propose targeted corrective actions and preventive measures that strengthen platform resilience and reduce revenue impact caused by service disruptions.
* Guide migration initiatives where legacy routing components are transitioned to modern Cloud Router and React Router based designs ensuring minimal downtime structured cutover plans and transparent communication to affected business units.
* Coordinate with security and compliance specialists to ensure routing solutions meet data protection standards logging expectations and regulatory obligations especially for clients in highly regulated telecom and digital billing environments.
* Support capacity planning and forecasting by modeling traffic patterns and growth scenarios so that router topologies scale effectively without unnecessary cost while sustaining consistent experience for end users.
* Advise client stakeholders on hybrid work collaboration practices and tooling that keep project communication clear and traceable across onsite and remote participants while maintaining focus on delivery outcomes and accountability.
* Craft concise yet informative presentations and walkthroughs that help client management understand routing solution benefits risk mitigations and alignment with broader digital transformation initiatives.
* Coordinate testing strategies including functional performance and failover tests to validate routing behavior across ICM Router Servers Cloud Router components and React Router paths before production deployment.
* Mentor junior team members in structured analysis techniques solution documentation practices and router technology fundamentals so that team capability grows and project delivery remains sustainable.


**Qualifications**
* Demonstrate strong hands on expertise in ICM Router Servers with proven experience in designing configuring and optimizing complex routing scenarios for medium to large enterprises.
* Bring solid practical experience in React Router for modern web applications including route design navigation patterns and error handling that supports intuitive and resilient user flows.
* Apply advanced Cloud Router knowledge across at least one major cloud environment with emphasis on scalable routing inter service communication and secure connectivity between distributed components.
* Leverage domain exposure in telecom to interpret routing and integration needs related to network services subscriber management and quality of service expectations that influence solution choices.
* Utilize familiarity with billing and revenue management processes to ensure routing and integration designs support accurate rating invoicing and revenue assurance flows without bottlenecks or data loss.
* Exhibit strong consulting skills including structured problem solving stakeholder communication and clear documentation that enable effective collaboration in a hybrid work setting with day shift operations.

description:

 We’re Fiserv, a global leader in Fintech and payments, and we move money and information in a way that moves the world. **Job Title**

**About Your Role**
 You will join Fiserv in a quality assurance role supporting critical testing initiatives across compliance, business\-as\-usual releases, and migration programs. * Act as an incident management lead during dress rehearsal and go\-live events for assigned projects.
* Participate in continuous improvement activities to strengthen test processes, deliverables, and quality outcomes.
* Responsibilities listed are not intended to be all\-inclusive and may be modified as necessary.


**Experience You’ll Need To Have**
* 4\+ years of experience in test planning, test execution, and test documentation for enterprise application testing projects.
* 4\+ years of experience in VisionPLUS modules, including CMS, FAS, TRAMS, and ITS.
* 4\+ years of experience in preparing test plans, test scenarios, and detailed test scripts from business requirements and functional specification documents.

* 4\+ years of experience in automated test case creation, maintenance, and execution using test automation frameworks.

* Experience with presentment file preparation and validation for card scheme testing.
* Experience using AI tools such as Copilot or Claude to improve test design, script creation, or test execution workflows.
* Experience supporting compliance testing, migration programs, and production readiness events in financial services.

title: ERP Functional QA Tester
description:
**Job Title:** 
 ERP Functional QA Tester
 



**Location:** 
 Chennai (Hybrid)
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



**Experience:** 
 1–2 years
 



  





**About the Role** 




  We are looking for an ERP Functional QA Tester to validate the customizations and configurations on ERP platform for client implementations. You'll work closely with implementation consultants and developers to test business workflows against client requirements and ensuring every customization actually works the way the client's business runs, before it goes live.
 



 We need someone who understands core business processes — accounting, buying, selling, manufacturing in particular and can think like an end user (accountant, production supervisor, storekeeper) to catch functional gaps.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




 ·      Review client requirement documents/BRDs and translate them into test scenarios and test cases
 



 ·      Test end\-to\-end business flows for customizations built on the ERP (forms, workflows, reports, print formats, permissions, email automations)
 



 ·      Validate manufacturing flows: BOM (Bill of Materials), Work Order, Job Card, material consumption, production stock movement
 



 ·      Validate accounting flows: sales/purchase invoicing, payments, journal entries, ledger impact, GST/tax calculations, stock\-to\-accounts reconciliation
 



 ·      Validate Buying flows: Sales order to Sales Invoice conversion
 



 ·      Perform functional, integration, and regression testing before client UAT and go\-live
 



 ·      Log defects clearly (steps to reproduce, expected vs actual result) and track them to closure with the dev team
 



 ·      Support clients during UAT by clarifying flows and re\-validating fixes
 



 ·      Maintain test case documentation and sign\-off checklists for each client deliverable
 



  
 **What We're Looking For** 




 ·      1–2 years of experience in an accounting, manufacturing/production, or ERP functional/support role
 



 ·      Solid understanding of core accounting concepts (invoices, ledgers, payments, GST taxes)
 



 ·      Understanding of manufacturing process flow: BOM → Work Order → Job Card → finished goods
 



 ·      Prior exposure to any ERP system (SAP, Oracle, Odoo, Frappe/ERPNext, Tally, Zoho, MS Dynamics, etc.) is a strong plus
 



 ·      Detail\-oriented, methodical, and comfortable following/writing structured test cases
 



 ·      Good communication skills since you'll be interfacing with client requirements and internal dev teams
 



 ·      Basic comfort with Excel/Sheets and any bug\-tracking tool is a plus
